articles.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
articles.content: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

articles.title_zh: RAPID: 示范机器人代理编程
articles.content_zh: 编码代理人在解决复杂的编程问题上表现出了巨大的成功. 为了发挥机器人系统的潜力,本作引入了来自演示的机器人代理编程(RAPID),通过一个单一的视觉人类演示,自动生成,验证并完善机器人程序. 代码完善的迭代代理循环需要几种关键成分:(一)可测试的任务规格,(二)机器人执行的动作原始,(三)程序执行和核查的交互环境. RAPID从演示中自动推断出所有三个. 为使由此产生的程序在演示设置之外可以再被使用,RAPID使用一个以对象为中心的关系程序表示,它侧重于被演示策略的内在结构,而不是特定运动本身:它表达动作原始为能实现物体级运动效应的轨迹-优化程序,同时通过关系约束来组合它们,在运行时捕捉场景特有几何. 我们在模拟八项具有挑战性的富于接触的非全面操纵任务以及LIBERO-Pro基准的一般全面操纵任务时对RAPID进行了评估。 我们还成功地将其部署在真正的Franka臂上,并对所有8个非全面任务进行评估。 在所有实验中,RAPID表现出了很强的性能,对物体的外观、外形、材料和环境进行了概括。 网站:https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

articles.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
articles.content: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 滚出WAM:有滚出想象的世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)将行动一代与未来的机器人操纵视觉预测结合起来。 然而,在每个重新规划周期完成联合视频-行动解禁进程,需要相当长的时间,推迟行动更新,限制闭路反应。 我们提出滚动WAM,一种将联合发号施令分配到相继的再规划周期的配方。 我们的方法维持一个滑动窗口 视频动作块 在交错的噪音水平。 在每一步,一个滚动的噪音表会完全暴露即将执行的动作块,同时部分地提炼出更远的未来块. 随着窗口随着新相机观测的推进,所保留的未来块继续其去名过程. 这可以随时间推移而分配计算成本,同时带有一个不断变化的跨块边界的视觉动作上下文. 对LIBERO,RoboTwin的评价以及一款现实世界Unitree G1人相片显示,Rolling-WAM实现了竞争性操纵性能. 通过从零开始去除整个预测地平线的需要,它提供了4.5x稳态再规划速度高于标准联合WAM.

articles.title: Towards Practical Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage. Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding. Meanwhile, floating-point context inference can introduce numerical inconsistencies across platforms, causing entropy-decoding failures. To address these practical challenges, we propose COSA-GS, which constructs context without spatial aggregation through anchor-wise causal factorization. Specifically, we use geometry context derived from each anchor's coordinates to model a compact learnable anchor latent. The anchor latent is then fused with the geometry context to form an anchor context for attribute coding. The resulting context model features a simple architecture composed solely of linear transformations and activations. We train COSA-GS using rate--distortion optimization with adaptive Gaussian pruning. Further, we develop quantization-aware training and integer inference for the context model to achieve bit-exact consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms. Experiments demonstrate that COSA-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance while retaining fast and consistent cross-platform decoding, providing a simple yet effective framework for practical 3DGS compression. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/COSA-GS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 3D高斯平板电脑的实用压缩
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)可以进行高质量的小说-视野合成,但需要大量存储. 现有的压缩方法往往依赖于空间上下文模型而不是不规则的3D表示,增加了培训和编码的复杂性. 同时,浮点上下文推论可以引入跨平台的数值不一致,导致肽解码失败. 为了应对这些实际挑战,我们建议COSA-GS通过锚地因子化,在没有空间聚合的情况下构建环境。 具体地说,我们使用从每个锚地坐标中衍生出来的几何背景来模拟一个可学习的紧凑锚地潜入. 锚潜被与几何上下文相接以形成属性编码的锚上下文. 由此产生的上下文模型的特点是一个完全由线性转换和活化组成的简单架构. 我们训练COSA-GS 使用 速率扭曲优化 与适应性高斯跑。 此外,我们为上下文模型开发了分量-意识培训和整数推论,以实现跨平台的偶数-解码符号的一致性。 实验表明COSA-GS实现了最先进的压缩性能,同时保留了快而一致的跨平台解码,为实用的3DGS压缩提供了简单而有效的框架. 代码见https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/COSA-GS.

articles.title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
articles.content: Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. However, these methods still suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance due to the lack of high-level semantic grounding in partially observed multimodal evidence. To address these issues, we propose SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that constructs rich sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs, fully integrating with all modalities via anchor-free spectral alignment. It mainly consists of Cross-modal Semantic Refinement (CSR) and Cross-modal Spectral Alignment (CSA). Specifically, CSR first adaptively extracts visual and acoustic representations by corresponding adapters to form a unified multimodal prefix with language in the frozen LLM embedding space. It then iteratively produces continuous discriminative semantic states through a token-efficient latent refinement process without decoding explicit text. Next, CSA simultaneously aligns the refined semantics with all modalities by enhancing the dominant spectral component of their kernel Gram matrix. This captures global nonlinear dependencies among all representations without relying on a predefined anchor modality. In addition, an instance-level spectral separation constraint preserves cross-sample discriminability and mitigates representation collapse. Extensive experiments on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that SemMSA achieves state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SemMSA:有不完整数据的Latet语义辅助强力多式传感器分析
articles.content_zh: 最近对多模式感知分析(MSA)的研究侧重于从语言,视觉,和声学模式中学习,数据不全可以推断出人类的情绪. 大多数研究通常通过重建模式特征或设计复杂的聚变机制来弥补缺失的信息. 然而,由于在部分观察到的多式联运证据中缺乏高层次的语义基础,这些方法仍然受到虚假的生成和噪音的引导。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用SemMSA这一潜在的语义辅助框架,用LLMs构建与情绪相关的丰富的语义,并通过无锚谱相接与所有模式充分结合。 它主要由"跨模式语义精准"(CSR)和"跨模式分光调和"(CSA)组成. 具体而言,CSR首先适应性地从相应的适配器中提取视觉和相声表现,以形成一个统一的多模式前缀并带有被冻结的LLM嵌入空间中语言. 然后,它通过一种象征性的高效的潜在完善过程,而无需对明文文本进行解码,反复产生持续的歧视性语义状态。 其次,加空局通过增强内核克拉姆矩阵的主要光谱成分,同时将精细语义与所有模式相协调. 这捕捉了全球所有代表的非线性依赖性,而不依赖于预先确定的锚定模式。 此外,实例一级的光谱分离制约保持了跨样本的可分性并缓解了代表性崩溃. 对SIMS,MOSI,MOSEI基准的广泛实验表明,SemMSA实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: OmniFabric: Coherent UV Space Texture Synthesis for 3D Garment Reconstruction
articles.content: Automated generation of production-ready 3D garment assets from a single image is a central challenge in digital content creation. While recent generative models have significantly advanced 3D geometry reconstruction, synthesizing high-quality textures remains a bottleneck. Existing methods often bake environmental illumination and shadows directly into the texture map, or they fail to maintain global structural coherence, making the resulting assets unusable for physical simulation and relighting. In this work, we introduce OmniFabric, a novel approach that synthesizes globally coherent texture maps directly within the 2D sewing pattern space. Given a single reference image, our pipeline utilizes an estimated 3D mesh and generative priors of powerful Vision-Language Models (VLM) to establish a complete but coarse texture initialization across the unwrapped sewing patterns. We then leverage a specialized diffusion transformer, trained via an automated synthetic data engine and conditioned on 3D positional features, to refine this initialization directly in the canonical UV domain. This effectively removes distortion and baked-in artifacts to extract a clean and normalized texture map that preserves the original garment design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniFabric significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding photorealistic 3D garments with high-quality textures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniFabric: 三维服装重建的一致紫外线空间纹理合成
articles.content_zh: 从单一图像自动生成生产准备的3D服装资产,是数字内容创建的一个中心挑战. 虽然最近的基因模型已经显著地推进了3D几何重建,但合成出高质量的纹理仍然是一个瓶颈. 现有方法往往会将环境发光和阴影直接放入纹理图中,或者无法保持全球结构的一致性,使得由此产生的资产无法用于物理模拟和再点亮. 在这部作品中,我们引入了"OmniFabric"(OmniFabric),这是一种新颖的方法,它直接在2D缝纫图案空间内合成全球一致的纹理图. 鉴于一个单一的参考图像,我们的管道利用强大的视觉-语言模型(VLM)的估计3D网目和遗传学前科,在未包装的缝纫模式中建立完整而粗糙的纹理初始化。 然后我们利用一台专门的扩散变压器,通过自动合成数据引擎进行训练,并以3D定位特性为条件,直接在舟体紫外线域上完善这种初始化. 这有效地消除了扭曲并烤入的文物取出保存了原服装设计的干净而规范的纹理图. 广泛的实验表明,OmniFabric的性能大大超过最先进的基线,产生了具有高质量纹理的光能3D服装.

articles.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
articles.content: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PoEM:从现有政策中预测RL成果
articles.content_zh: 基础模型通过强化学习(RL)进行后培训,以尽量扩大具体奖励,例如人与人结合、正确性或随行的教学。 这个训练后的过程在计算上是密集的,有时是不稳定的,必须从零开始运行,每次奖励模式改变,或者当我们想结合多种奖励时,都要从零开始运行. 因此,我们问:鉴于新的奖励功能,在不实际运行RL的情况下,是否能够预测RL结果? 我们以肯定的方式回答这个问题,引入了PoEM,这是一个框架,利用一套已经经过其他奖励培训的模式,预测RL在新的奖励职能方面的产出。 首先,我们表明,如果新的奖励函数可以被写成现有函数的线性组合,那么日志空间中的新政策就可以被写成现有日志策略的线性组合. 令人惊讶的是,即使在奖励没有线性联系的情况下,我们发现,来自RL训练的日志政策往往跨越了大约低等的亚空间,跨越奖励。 为了我们的利益,这种组合的加权系数只能利用抽样的奖励或政策产出的依据来估计。 我们把这些观测结果变成一个算法,它使用经过后训练的模型和新的奖励功能,并且不实际运行任何附加的RL训练而大致地计算目标RL政策. 我们通过综合和真实的奖励,包括文字和图像模式,试验验证我们的方法。

articles.title: BiCC: Bidirectional Connected-Component Loss for Instance-Aware Segmentation
articles.content: Common segmentation losses aggregate errors voxel-wise, so lesions influence the objective in proportion to their volume, giving small but clinically critical lesions disproportionately little weight. Instance-aware losses aim to address this mismatch by assigning each lesion its own term. However, blob loss and CC-DiceCE derive their regions solely from annotations, so false-positive components receive no instance-level term. This matters in computer-assisted review, where each false-positive component may require separate inspection, making precision and false-positive burden important alongside recall. We introduce the bidirectional connected-component loss (BiCC), which pairs annotation- and prediction-derived partitions to score predicted components on their own scale. By deriving instances from the predictions, this branch directly penalizes false-positive components regardless of their size. The balance parameter $α$ allows control over the lesion-wise precision-recall trade-off. Across five datasets with five-fold cross-validation using nnU-Net, BiCC outperforms CC-DiceCE in lesion-wise F1 on four datasets and blob loss on all five. It significantly improves over DiceCE on three datasets and matches it on two; CC-DiceCE instead loses up to 0.363 precision by favoring recall. Code is available at https://github.com/TIO-IKIM/BiCC-Loss.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BIC: 实例- 软件分割的双向连接组件损失
articles.content_zh: 常见的分化损失了综合误差(voxel-wiside),因此损伤会按照其体积的比例影响目标,给小但临床上临界的损伤带来不成比例的轻重. 体会到损失的目的是通过确定每一损害本身的期限来解决这种不匹配。 然而,blob lose和CC-DiceCE仅仅从说明中得出它们的区域,所以假阳性成分得不到例级术语. 在计算机辅助审查中,这个问题涉及每个虚假阳性成分可能需要单独检查,从而使精确和虚假阳性负担与召回一样重要。 我们引入了双向连接组件损失(BICC),它将注释和预测生成的分区相配,以对预测组件进行自己的分数。 通过从预测中推导出的情况,这个分支直接惩罚假阳性成分,而不论其大小. 余额参数为α美元,可以控制损害的精确-召回权衡。 使用nnU-Net进行五倍交叉验证的五套数据集,在四套数据集中,BIC在损害情况下的CC-DiceCE优于四套数据集,所有五套数据集的blob损失。 它大大改进了三个数据集的DiceCE,并将其相匹配到两个数据集;而CC-DiceCE却因倾向于召回而损失了高达0.363的精度. 代码见https://github.com/TIO-IKIM/BICC-Loss.

articles.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
articles.content: Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.

articles.title_zh: 音轨 所有东西: 长地平线 通过去重复的 三维场景显示器进行感知跟踪
articles.content_zh: 现有点追踪模型面临一个根本的取舍:它们可以追踪一串在长地平线上行走的稀有的查询点,或者只追踪短片段上的所有点. 我们引入了 Track Everything, 一个3D点追踪器,通过在世界坐标中将视频作为持续的3D场景轨道来打破这种取舍. 影片是三维世界的二维预测, 追踪万事俱备的模型复杂度与视频持续时间, 我们的方法引入了三大创新。 首先,我们在滑行-窗口边界上采用以活化为主的去重复机制来合并同地轨道,防止重复地观测同一地表的重复积累. 第二,我们把跟踪分解成一个端点精炼器,预测每个分点的去向和静态与动力的分类,然后是轻量级的轨迹精炼器,专门为动态分点解密轨迹. 第三,我们提出3D WAFT,用场景云中的高效地物采样来取而代之的是内存-禁止的4D相关体积. 据我们所知, Track Everything是第一个3D跟踪器,能够追踪超过1000帧的视频在40GB的GPU内存中的所有可见点. 在TAPVid-3D,轨道 在短片上,每件事物都比所有开源全帧密集的3D跟踪器多出20%以上的APD,同时在长片序上仍然与最先进的稀有跟踪器保持竞争,尽管跟踪的分数要多得多.

articles.title: WanPE: Towards Cinematic Prompt Enhancement for Modern Text-to-Video Generation
articles.content: Video generation begins in text space by authoring a cinematic screenplay, then materializes into pixels. As contemporary video generators scale to 30 seconds and faithfully follow complex conditions, the textual prompt largely directs the production, planning how actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound unfold across multi-shot sequences. In this paper, we present WanPE, a 397B-parameter prompt enhancement model trained on 1.05M real-world videos to master director-level cinematic planning. WanPE formulates shot-level cinematic plans via video-grounded reverse construction and employs Semantic-Consistency GRPO (SC-GRPO) to faithfully preserve user requirements across shots and over time. To benchmark this capability, we curate WanPEval, a human-annotated testbed covering durations from 5 to 30 seconds across varying intent granularities, supported by approximately 11K blind pairwise assessments. When powering Wan3.0's video generator, WanPE-397B boosts human preference over raw user prompts by 10.66-18.84 points at 5-15 seconds and by a dramatic 50.86 points in the 30-second arena. Ablation studies show that reverse construction demonstrates clear superiority over forward rewriting, while SC-GRPO robustly preserves semantic fidelity across model scales. Ultimately, WanPE leads all evaluated commercial offerings at 5-15 seconds and remains competitive with Seedance 2.5 at 30 seconds.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WanPE: 迈向电影快速增强现代文本到视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视频生成开始于文本空间,先是编剧出一部电影剧本,再实现为像素. 随着当代视频生成器的规模达到30秒并忠实地遵循了复杂的条件,文字快取在很大程度上指导了制作,规划了动作,相机轨迹,照明,和声音如何跨多镜头序列的展开. 在本文中,我们介绍了WanPE,一个397B参数的即时增强模型,该模型在1.05M真实世界视频上接受了培训,用于导演级电影总规划. WanPE通过以视频为基础的倒置建筑来制定拍摄级别的电影计划,并使用语义-一致性GRPO(SC-GRPO)来忠实地维护拍摄期间和一段时间内用户的要求. 为了确定这种能力的基准,我们管理WanPEval,这是一个人类附加说明的试验台,涵盖5至30秒不等的不同意图颗粒,并辅之以大约11K盲双相评估。 WanPE-397B为Wan3.0的视频生成器提供动力时,将人比生用户的偏好提升到10.66-18.84分以5-15秒的速度取出,30秒竞技场则以50.86分的戏剧性取出. 校正研究表明,反向构造显示出明显优于前向重写,而SC-GRPO则有力地保留了模型尺度的语义忠诚. 最终,WanPE在5至15秒领先所有被评价的商业提供品,并在30秒与种子2.5保持竞争力.

articles.title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Layer-wise visual-text similarity in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is widely interpreted as evidence that the language model progressively integrates visual content into a shared representation space. This reading rests on the assumption that scalar alignment scores reflect content-level cross-modal interaction. To test this assumption, we apply controlled interventions to the visual stream. Across 13 MLLMs from five families spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters, replacing projector-output visual tokens with Gaussian noise sharply reduces task accuracy, yet four standard scalar measures (CKA, SVCCA, MIR, and the leading principal-angle cosine) fail to consistently separate the corrupted stream from the original. We call this failure the alignment illusion and trace it to the shared language-model pathway: anisotropic MLP down-projections pull visual and text tokens toward common output directions, producing weight-induced alignment. Because this component is essentially one-dimensional, we introduce the principal-angle gap (PA gap), defined as the difference between the top two principal-angle cosines, which separates weight-induced similarity from multi-directional visual structure. Under graded visual corruption, the PA gap tracks task accuracy more consistently than the scalar scores we consider; under a structured but irrelevant image, it further exposes regimes in which internal geometry and task accuracy come apart. Internal visual-text alignment in MLLMs is therefore best read as a geometric diagnostic of the visual stream inside the language model rather than a direct proxy for content-level cross-modal interaction, and is most informative when calibrated by controlled task evidence.

articles.title: Ego-Exo4D Human Meshes Dataset: 4D Human Motion Reconstruction for Ego-Exo Captures
articles.content: Ego-Exo4D is a large-scale dataset providing synchronized egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, a rich resource for skill learning and assessment, procedural activity understanding, and embodied AI. However, the dataset ships with only sparse 3D human pose annotations, and reconstructing dense human motion from its multi-view captures is nontrivial. To this end, we present Ego-Exo4D-HM, a large-scale dataset of 4D human motion reconstructions for Ego-Exo4D's captures, and release the accompanying reconstruction pipeline. The code, dataset, and documentation can be found at https://abhiram824.github.io/egoexo4d_human_meshes.

articles.title: Multimodal Thinking with Renderable Programs
articles.content: Current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at visual content understanding and text-based reasoning, yet their structure limits the advancement of incorporating images into the reasoning chain. Though Omnimodal models have made efforts in unifying text and image generation, they focus on visual tasks in the open-domain, lacking tractability due to rasterized or latent representations of images. We introduce SVGLM, a framework that uses scalable vector graphics (SVG) primitives to connect text and image in reasoning tasks. We exploit the duality of SVG as both image description and text instructions, yielding a more compact, interpretable solution to equip general VLMs with the capability of generating images within the reasoning process. We provide a large curated dataset of SVG-based image editing dataset, as well as the paradigm to tune open-source VLMs. Experiments on a mathematical reasoning benchmark demonstrate that SVGLM achieves strong SVG generation power as well as think-with-image intelligence. Our results highlight SVG as a suitable medium for building more robust digital domain agents, bridging the gap between text-based thinking and pixel-based images.

articles.title_zh: 与可复制程序进行多式联运思考
articles.content_zh: 当前的视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉内容理解和以文字为基础的推理方面表现优异,然而其结构限制了将图像融入推理链的进步. 虽然Omnimodule模型在统一文本和图像生成方面做出了努力,但它们侧重于开放域的可视任务,由于图像的光栅化或潜在表现而缺乏可取性. 我们引入了SVGLM,这个框架在推理任务中使用可伸缩矢量图形(SVG)原始来连接文本和图像. 我们利用SVG作为图像描述和文本指示的双重性,产生了更紧凑,可解释的解决方案,使一般的VLM具备在推理过程中生成图像的能力. 我们提供了一个基于SVG的图像编辑数据集的大型编译数据集,以及调取开源VLM的范式. 对数学推理基准的实验表明,SVGLM实现了强大的SVG发电功率以及有思维的图像智能. 我们的成果凸显出SVG是构建更坚固的数字域代理的合适媒介,弥合了以文字为基础的思维和以像素为基础的图像之间的差距.

articles.title: What, When, and How: Audio Description as Constrained Global Optimization
articles.content: Audio Description (AD) makes movies accessible to blind and visually impaired audiences by narrating visual information in gaps between dialogue. Existing automatic AD systems largely treat generation as a local video-to-text problem, assuming that the content to describe and its temporal location are already provided. Realistic AD instead requires coupled decisions about what visual information is narratively important, when it can be spoken without interfering with dialogue, and how it should be formulated to fit within the available time. We formalize AD generation as a constrained optimization problem over these three decisions. Our hybrid system uses large language models to propose and ground visual elements, estimate their salience to the narrative, and generate compressed realizations. A mixed-integer linear program then jointly selects and schedules descriptions across a scene subject to temporal constraints. When evaluated on REFRAMED, a benchmark for realistic AD of movies, our approach makes better decisions than prompted LLMs about what to describe and when to describe it, establishing a new SOTA on narrative QA and temporally grounded metrics. Ablations show that explicit temporal constraints drive gains in placement, while salience estimation controls how much narratively useful content is retained. Improvements are concentrated on temporal and narrative measures rather than n-gram overlap, although a significant gap to professional describers remains.

articles.title_zh: What, When, and How: 音频描述为约束全球优化
articles.content_zh: 音频描述(AD)通过对对话间差距的视觉信息进行描述,使盲人和视障观众能够观看电影。 现有的自动自动开发系统基本上将生成视为当地视频到文本的问题,假定已经提供了描述的内容及其时间位置。 现实的反倾销需要就哪些视觉信息在叙事上很重要、何时可以说话而不干扰对话以及如何在现有时间内加以拟订作出共同的决定。 我们把AD生成正规化,作为这三项决定的制约性优化问题。 我们的混合系统使用大型语言模型来提出并地面视觉元素,估计其对叙事的显著性,并产生压缩的实现. 混合整数线性程序然后在时间限制下共同选择和安排一个场景的描述. 在作为现实的AD电影基准的REFRAMED上评价时,我们的方法作出更好的决定,而不是促使LLMs对如何描述和何时描述它,建立一个关于叙述性质量和基于时间的衡量标准的新SOTA。 缺省表明,明确的时间限制促使在安放方面有所进展,而突出的估计则控制了保留多少叙述性有用的内容。 改进集中在时间和叙事措施上,而不是正克重叠,尽管对专业描述者来说仍存在很大差距。

articles.title: Smartphone-Based Method for Automated Speed Enforcement
articles.content: Smartphone cameras and computer vision (CV) hold significant promise in assisting public agencies with enforcing traffic laws and enhancing road safety. This work designs and tests a smartphone-based method for automated speed estimation and vehicle identification (license plate, make/model, and color recognition) via an automated pipeline to assist enforcement agencies in reliably identifying speeders. The CV code accurately recognizes nearly half (46%) of the license plates' text on 1,800 images from a Brazil open-source dataset, called UFPR-ALPR. Code tests on daytime recordings from hand-held smartphone videos (n = 73) and roadside cameras (n = 42) in Austin, Texas yield 60.8% accuracy for color detection (among all possible RGB color categories), 48.6% on vehicle make/manufacturer identification, and 16.89% on vehicle make and model identification. Prediction accuracy for speed estimation (within a 20% range), vehicle make (within the top 3 predictions), and license plate recognition (within the top 10 predictions) are 16.3%, 16.9%, and 29.7%, respectively. This paper also illuminates the legal, technological, and practical aspects of using smartphones for enforcement, including the potential use of recordings for enforcement purposes, emphasizing the need to transform the potential of smartphone-based CV technologies into practical tools for vital information on traffic violations.

articles.title_zh: 基于智能手机的自动速度执行方法
articles.content_zh: 智能手机相机和计算机视觉(CV)在协助公共机构执行交通法和加强道路安全方面有着巨大的希望。 这项工作通过自动管道设计和测试一种基于智能手机的自动速度估计和车辆识别方法(许可证牌、制造/模型和颜色识别),以协助执法机构可靠地识别速度器。 CV代码准确识别出巴西开源数据集UFPR-ALPR上1800个图像上近一半(46%)的牌照文本. 德克萨斯州奥斯汀的手持智能手机视频(n = 73)和路边相机(n = 42)的日间录音编码测试,显示60.8%的颜色检测精度(包括所有可能的RGB颜色类别),48.6%的车辆制作/制造者识别,16.89%的车辆制作和模型识别. 预测速度估计(在20%范围内)、车辆制造(在前3个预测范围内)和牌照识别(在前10个预测范围内)的准确性分别为16.3%、16.9%和29.7%。 本文还阐明了使用智能手机执法的法律、技术和实际方面,包括可能将录音用于执法目的,并强调需要将基于智能手机的CV技术的潜力转化为交通违规重要信息的实用工具。

articles.title: Accelerating Video Diffusion via Training-Free Trajectory Routing
articles.content: Video diffusion is computationally expensive, as it requires executing a large model across many denoising steps. Even with step-distillation, inference remains expensive because every distilled step still requires a costly model evaluation. We present TRACK: TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection, a heterogeneous denoising strategy that switches between compatible large and small models at selected steps, reducing the average cost per denoising evaluation. The switching steps are determined using a calibration process. TRACK first rolls out a reference trajectory with the large model. Then at each step, the small model's prediction is also collected and compared against the large model's prediction to obtain a relative disagreement score. Both models receive the same latent, timestep, conditioning, and guidance inputs. Aggregating this signal over a calibration set produces a disagreement score map across diffusion steps, which determines a switching policy for an efficient inference process: quality-sensitive steps keep using the large model, while steps with low disagreement scores are routed to the small model. Inference executes only the selected model at each step, requiring no retraining, architecture or scheduler changes, or online dual-model evaluation. Across Wan 2.1, Cosmos 3, TurboDiffusion, and FastVideo, TRACK yields $1.95\times$, $2.04\times$-$2.73\times$, $2.69\times$, and $2.17\times$ speedups, respectively, with comparable aggregate quality and high diversity retention. TRACK thereby establishes automated, training-free model switching as a practical acceleration paradigm for video diffusion.

articles.title_zh: 通过培训-无轨电车运行加速视频传播
articles.content_zh: 视频的传播在计算上是昂贵的,因为它需要在许多去名步骤中执行一个大模型。 即便采用分级稀释法,推论仍然很昂贵,因为每个分级步骤仍然需要昂贵的模型评估。 我们提出TRACK:TRajectory-Aware Cowlection通过上K选择的路由,这是一种不同的去名策略,在相容的大模型和小模型之间按选定的步骤切换,降低每次去名评价的平均成本. 转换步骤是通过校正过程确定的。 TRACK首先推出大模型的参考轨迹. 然后在每一个步骤上,小模型的预测也会被收集出来,并与大模型的预测相比较,以获得相对的分歧分数. 两种模型都得到同样的潜在、时间步骤、条件和指导投入。 将这个信号汇总在一个校正集上,产生出跨扩散步骤的分歧分数图,这决定了一个高效推论过程的切换政策:质量敏感的步骤继续使用大模型,而分歧分数较低的步骤则被路由到小模型. 推论只在每一步执行所选模式,不需要再培训,架构或调度器改变,或在线双模式评价. TRACK在Wan 2.1、Cosmos 3、TurboDifusion和FastVideo各处分别获得1.95美元、2.04美元-2.73美元、2.69美元和2.17美元,总质量和多样性保持率相当。 因此,TRACK将自动、无培训模式转换作为视频传播的实际加速模式。

articles.title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
articles.content: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate impressive capabilities in robotic manipulation, their memoryless nature renders them brittle to test-time environment shifts, particularly hardware shifts caused by wear or imperfect calibration. Enabling these models to self-adapt during deployment without requiring continuous on-site recalibration remains a critical bottleneck for real-world scalability. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive VLA, a novel post-training recipe that enables the policy to iteratively adapt to deployment-time hardware shifts leveraging its own rollouts as context. To do so, we first collect policy rollouts under deliberately injected hardware shifts. We then transform the base policy's training data into shift-conditioned expert demonstrations by pre-compensating the expert actions for these known shifts. Next, we introduce a lightweight, plug-in context encoder that compresses the context, including visual observation, proprioception, and actions in the shifted environment, into a latent context token. This token modulates the policy through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN). Furthermore, we find that context tokens can be ensembled, allowing the policy to iteratively self-correct and mitigate failures step by step. Extensive experiments across four precision-critical bi-manual and dexterous manipulation tasks show that Self-Adaptive VLA recovers over 80% of the base policy's performance under hardware shifts, such as actuation bias and joint encoder offsets. Moreover, Self-Adaptive VLA enables more robust deployment to new workstations compared to the base policy. Our approach provides a pathway for robust large-scale real-world robot deployments and easier maintenance. See videos at https://icefoxzhx.github.io/self-adaptive-vla.

articles.title_zh: 机动机器人部署的自适应性VLA
articles.content_zh: 虽然Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型在机器人操纵方面表现出了令人印象深刻的能力,但是其无记忆的本质使得它们难以适应测试时的环境变化,尤其是由磨损或校正不完善而导致的硬件转移. 使这些模型在部署期间能够自我适应,而不需要持续的现场再校正,仍然是现实世界可扩展性的一个关键瓶颈。 在这项工作中,我们引入了自导自演的VLA,这是一种全新的培训后配方,它使政策能够反复地适应部署时的硬件转移,利用自身推出的背景。 为此,我们首先在有意注入的硬件转换下收集政策推广。 然后,我们将基础政策的培训数据转化为有变换条件的专家示范,为这些已知的转变预先补偿专家行动。 接下来,我们引入一个轻量级,插件上下文编码器,压缩上下文,包括视觉观察,自发性,以及改变环境中的行动,成为潜在的上下文符号. 这一标志通过适应层正常化(AdaLN)来修改政策. 此外,我们发现,环境标志可以齐头并进,使政策能够反复自我纠正并逐步减少失败。 跨越4个精密临界双手动和有弹性操纵任务的广泛实验显示自导自能VLA在硬件转移下恢复了基础政策80%以上的性能,如活性偏差和联合编码器抵消. 此外,与基地政策相比,自适应性VLA能够更有力地部署到新的工作站。 我们的方法为强大的大规模实际世界机器人部署和更容易的维护提供了一条途径。 见https://icefoxzhx.github.io/自适应-vla。

articles.title: Can Frozen Hyperspherical Features Guide the Selection of Pseudo Masks?
articles.content: Foundation segmenters such as SAM return several plausible masks for an unlabeled image, and a student trained on the wrong one inherits its errors. Choosing among them means querying a second large model or fitting a quality head to annotated masks. We show that a candidate can be judged by what it does to a frozen self-supervised backbone's features. Normalized DINOv2 patch features lie on a hypersphere, and a candidate mask splits that sphere in two. Based on this reading, we introduce SphereTrust, which scores each candidate by three properties of the split, the angular contrast between the two sides, the coverage of the foreground's appearance modes, and contact with the image frame, one for each of three common ways a mask fails, and ranks a pool in 0.55 s per image from the frozen features alone. On eight SAM and SAM3 candidate pools spanning camouflaged, salient, and dichotomous segmentation and camouflage under low light, SphereTrust exceeds the strongest evaluated external baseline on six pools by 1.7 to 9.3 percentage points in mean selected Dice. These comparisons include published selection rules and explicitly labeled adaptations of DSS and UCOD-MKD. On the two prompted camouflage pools, its mean selected Dice is within 0.1 percentage points of the candidate-derived DSS adaptation, with a lower catastrophic-error rate. Which cue carries the signal depends on the candidate pool. The same sphere also supports training. The leading candidates enter as a candidate set with their scores as priors, prototypes reorder them, and a cross-fitted second round completes the labels, raising weighted F by 4.5, 2.3, and 5.5 points over fixed-label training on the three MLLM anchor pools, with students competitive with published unsupervised methods on nineteen test sets.

articles.title: M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis
articles.content: Robotic novel view synthesis (NVS) must recover both visual appearance and metric 3D structure, yet most generative NVS methods rely only on images, overlooking LiDAR, a complementary sensor common on robotic platforms. We present M3GD, a Camera--LiDAR multimodal representation for generative NVS that composes independently pretrained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation models without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator. We show that, after camera projection, frozen LiDAR and image features exhibit substantial shared spatial structure, providing a natural cross-modal representation. M3GD conditions generation on LiDAR through this structure: it combines explicit geometry statistics with learned point-cloud descriptors into view-aligned packets on the image-latent grid, injected through a lightweight residual adapter into a multi-view flow-matching generator whose latent space, decoders, and training objective remain intact. On the GrandTour dataset, M3GD improves target-view RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version of the same backbone. Ablations show that the gains come from pixel-aligned LiDAR content and that target-view LiDAR acts as a geometric query linking the requested view to source observations. Deployment on a ground robot demonstrates practical real-world operation, with a configurable quality--cost trade-off controlled by the number of Euler integration steps.

articles.title_zh: M3GD:相机-LiDAR多相机多相机多相机几何扩散 小说视图合成
articles.content_zh: 机器人小说取景合成(NVS)必须同时恢复视觉外观和公制3D结构,然而大多数基因取景的NVS方法只依靠图像,俯瞰机器人平台上常见的一种互补传感器LiDAR. 我们提出M3GD,一种用于基因NVS的相机-LiDAR多模式表示,它独立地编写预先训练的2D图像和3D点-云基模型,而不单独预先训练跨模式翻译。 我们显示,相机投影后,冷冻的LiDAR和图像特征呈现出大量共享的空间结构,提供了自然的跨模式表现. M3GD通过这种结构在LiDAR上产生条件:它将清晰的几何统计与所学的点-云描述符合并成图像相向网格上的取景包,通过轻量级剩余适配器注入多视相相向相向的生成器,其潜在的空间,解码器,以及训练目标保持不变. 在GrandTour数据集上,M3GD改进了目标-视图RGB和深度合成,比起同一主干线的只图像版本. 缩写显示增益来自像素相通的LiDAR内容,而目标视图LiDAR起到连接所请求的视图与源观测的几何查询的作用. 地面机器人的部署展现出实用的现实世界操作,可配置的质量成本取舍由欧拉整合步骤的数量控制.

articles.title: ConPro: Contrast Projection Pretraining for Label-Efficient Vessel Segmentation in DSA Sequences
articles.content: Dense vessel annotation in digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is labor-intensive, yet every unlabeled sequence records how contrast passes through the vessels. Semi-supervised methods take their targets from the current model, and generic self-supervised pretexts reconstruct static appearance, so this signal goes unused. We propose ConPro, a self-supervised pretraining scheme whose target is a contrast projection, the normalized drop of every pixel below its temporal median over the sequence. On DIAS and DSCA, with 10%, 20% and 50% of the training cases labeled, ConPro improves on training from scratch at every label fraction and is the best of the compared methods on DSCA at 20% and 50% labels. Controlled comparisons show that the gain comes from the target. A temporal-median target with the same input, loss and budget stays at scratch level, and using the projection directly instead of learning it, as an input channel or a pseudo-label, helps little or hurts. ConPro provides pretrained weights without changing the segmentation architecture, so it combines with semi-supervised training, and UniMatch, the strongest baseline, gains 0.5 to 2.0 Dice and 0.9 to 2.3 clDice at every label fraction when started from ConPro weights, reaching 75.4 Dice on DIAS and 81.3 on DSCA.

articles.title_zh: ConPro:在DSA序列中标签-有效船舶分解的对比预测
articles.content_zh: 数字减法血管造影法(DSA)中的说明是劳动密集型的,但每个无标签的序列都记录着对比是如何穿过血管的。 半被监督的方法从目前的模型中取出他们的目标,而通用的自监督借口重建了静态外观,因此这个信号没有被使用. 我们提出康普罗,一个自我监督的预训计划,其目标为对比投影,每个像素在时间中位数下正常地下降,以超过序列. 在DIAS和DSCA中,有10%、20%和50%的培训案例被贴上标签,ConPro从头到尾改进了每个标签分数的培训,是DSCA中最好的比较方法,标签为20%和50%。 受控比较显示收益来自目标. 具有相同输入,损失和预算的时中位目标停留在抓取水平上,直接使用投影而不是学习,作为输入通道或伪标签,帮助很少或伤害. ConPro在不改变分块结构的情况下提供预受训练的权重,因此结合了半受监督的训练,而UniMatch,最强的基线,在从ConPro权重开始的每个标签分数上得到0.5到2.0分和0.9到2.3分ClDice,在DIAS上达到75.4分和在DSCA上达到81.3分.

articles.title: AERIAL: Adversarial Evaluation of Robustness in Accuracy-Preserving Low-Precision EEG Decoders
articles.content: Deployment-oriented compression is attractive for resource-constrained brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but whether it changes adversarial vulnerability remains unclear. On BCI Competition IV-2a, we compare 32-bit floating-point (FP32) EEGNet and ShallowConvNet models with global magnitude pruning and simulated INT8 post training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) across nine subjects and three seeds. Simulation provides differentiable quantize--dequantize models for white-box attacks and gradient analysis, while native TensorRT deployment is used for validation. Accuracy-preserving compression does not improve direct robustness: at $ε=0.005$, EEGNet PGD accuracy remains 22--24\% across FP32, 50\% pruning (P50), PTQ, and QAT. However, P50 reduces bidirectional transfer efficiency to 0.963/0.928 (FP32$\rightarrow$P50/P50$\rightarrow$FP32), versus 0.994/0.997 for PTQ; the same trend holds for ShallowConvNet. Gradient alignment shows a corresponding separation, while native PTQ agrees with simulated clean/adversarial predictions in 95--98\% of cases. These results show that direct robustness, adversarial transfer, and deployment efficiency are distinct properties of compressed EEG decoders.

articles.title_zh: AERIAL:对精度-保留低精度的 EEG 解码器的强性进行负面评价
articles.content_zh: 面向部署的压缩对受资源限制的大脑-计算机接口(BCI)具有吸引力,但这种压缩是否改变对抗性的脆弱性仍不清楚。 在BCI Conference IV-2a上,我们将32位浮点(FP32) EEGNet和ShallowConvNet模型与全局级的推算和模拟INT8后训练分量(PTQ)和分量-意识训练(QAT)进行比对,分9个科目和3个种子. 模拟为白箱攻击和梯度分析提供了可分化-分化模型,而本地的TensorRT部署则用于验证. 准确性保存压缩并不能改善直接的稳健性:在0.005美元时,EEGNet PGD精度在FP32、50-Q pruning(P50)、PTQ和QAT之间保持22-24. 然而,P50将双向转移效率降低到0.963/0.928 (FP32美元\直径为P50/P50美元\直径为FP32),而PTQ为0.994/0.997;ShallowConvNet的趋势也是如此。 渐变对接显示相应的分离,而本地PTQ则同意了95-98\%的模拟清洁/对抗预测. 这些结果表明,直接稳健性、对抗性转移和部署效率是压缩的EEG解码器的独特特性。

articles.title: Training-Free Hold-Usage Detection in Sport Climbing with Foundation Pose Models
articles.content: Detecting which holds a climber uses, and when, underpins automated scoring, movement analysis, and assistive systems for sport climbing. Existing approaches train task-specific models or repurpose 2D pose estimators whose hand keypoint sits at the wrist and foot keypoint at the ankle i.e. offset from the fingertips and toes that actually contact the holds, and whose hands are occluded in roughly half of all frames. We show that a frozen, off-the-shelf pose foundation model is sufficient: using the fingertip and toe keypoints of Sapiens, a per-frame proximity test against the annotated holds, per-limb mutual exclusion, and a short temporal-persistence rule, we detect hold usage without any climbing-specific training. On the The Way Up dataset (22 videos, 10 athletes, two routes), our method reaches an event F_1 of 90.2% on a held-out split (89.8% under leave-one-participant-out cross-validation) and 79.9% over all 22 videos at any temporal overlap, and performs best on footholds (F_1,89.8% overall, 96.6% held-out). Under an identical protocol it exceeds our reproductions of the YOLOv8-pose and ViTPose pipelines at every temporal threshold, with the margin widening under strict timing. An ablation shows that two intuitively helpful additions---dense foundation-feature change gating and body-part segmentation---both hurt, arguing that a minimal, keypoint-only design is the right one for this task. Finally, standard coaching statistics computed from our automatic predictions track ground truth closely (Pearson r=1.00 for climb time, 0.94 for pace), turning ordinary single-camera video into reliable performance metrics with no instrumentation.

articles.title_zh: 利用 " Pose " 基金会模式,在攀登运动中进行免费牵引检测
articles.content_zh: 检测登山者使用,以及何时支持运动登山的自动打分、运动分析和辅助系统。 现有方法训练特定任务模型或再用 2D 设置了估计器,其手键点坐落在脚踝的手腕和脚键点上,即从实际接触被扣的指尖和脚趾相抵消,其手被围住在所有框架的大约一半. 我们显示,一个冰冻的、现成的地基模型就足够了:利用萨皮恩斯的指尖和脚趾键位、针对附加说明的悬架的每帧近距离测试、相互排斥、以及短暂的时间-持久性规则,我们检测到在没有任何攀登特定训练的情况下持有使用量。 在The Way Up数据集(22个视频,10个运动员,两条路线)上,我们的方法达到一个活动F_1在被搁置的分出(89.8%在休假-一个参与者的交叉确认下)和79.9%在所有22个视频中在任何时间重叠,在立足点上表现最好(F_1,89.8%,搁置96.6%). 根据同样的协议,它超过了我们在每个时间阈值上复制YOLOv8-pose和ViTPose输油管,其比值在严格的时间范围内扩大。 一种通俗的说法表明,两个直观的有帮助的加法 - - - 深层地基 - 地貌变化的取向和身体部位分化 - - - 都伤害了,认为一个最小的,只有关键点的设计是这个任务正确的. 最后,从我们的自动预测中计算出标准辅导统计,跟踪地面真相(Pearson r=1.00用于攀登时间,0.94用于速度),将普通的单相机视频变成没有仪器的可靠性能指标.

articles.title: GHOST-Q: Towards Studying Grounding Hallucinations Overlooked Under Same-score TradeOffs in Quantized VLMS
articles.content: Post-training quantization of vision--language models (VLMs) is typically assessed through aggregate task accuracy and memory savings, but preserving a headline score does not guarantee preservation of visual grounding behavior. We present GHOST-Q, a cross-precision controlled evaluation of three 8B VLM families under FP16, INT8, and NF4 across utility and hallucination-sensitive benchmarks. Rather than comparing only aggregate accuracy, we pair FP16 and quantized predictions item by-item to quantify how compression redistributes grounding successes and failures. Five of six quantized variants preserve MMStar accuracy within $\pm2$ percentage points, yet 10 of 36 paired effects remain significant after false-discovery-rate correction, nine on hallucination-sensitive conditions. Same-device A100 profiling further demonstrates that substantial memory reduction does not necessarily mean lower inference latency. Finally, an open-ended AMBER audit reveals strong generation budget censoring whose severity varies by architecture and precision. These results show that quantized VLMs should be evaluated jointly for aggregate utility, grounding reliability, generation behavior, and realized deployment efficiency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GHOST-Q:致力于研究量化的VLMS中同分贸易下被忽略的幻觉
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLM)的训练后量化通常通过集合任务精度和内存节省来评估,但保留一个头条分数并不能保证视觉地平面行为的保存. 我们提出GHOST-Q,这是对FP16、INT8和NF4三个8B VLM家庭的跨度控制评价,跨越了对效用和幻觉敏感的基准。 我们不只比较总精度,而是将FP16和量化的预测项目逐项进行,以量化压缩如何重新分配成败。 6个被分解的变体中,有5个将MMStar精度维持在$\pm2美元百分点以内,然而36个对等效果中,有10个在被假发现率校正后仍然显著,9个在幻觉敏感条件下. 同分辨A100剖析进一步表明,大量内存的减少并不一定意味着较低的推论延迟. 最后,一次不限成员名额的AMBER审计显示,对一代人进行强有力的预算审查,其严重程度因结构和准确性而异。 这些结果表明,应联合评价被量化的VLM,以便综合使用、确定可靠性、生成行为和实现部署效率。

articles.title: OceanXL: Large-scale Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting via Block Partitioning and Adaptive Pruning
articles.content: Underwater 3D reconstruction is critical for marine exploration, ecological monitoring, and subsea infrastructure inspection, yet remains challenging at large scale due to light attenuation, scattering, and limited capture coverage. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality real-time rendering, its application to large underwater scenes is constrained by high memory consumption and inefficient optimization over extensive areas. We propose OceanXL, a fast and scalable 3DGS-based framework for large-scale underwater reconstruction. OceanXL adopts a divide-and-conquer strategy, partitioning scenes into spatially coherent blocks to enable efficient optimization while preserving global geometric consistency. We further introduce an adaptive pruning scheme tailored to underwater conditions that removes redundant primitives, producing compact representations without sacrificing visual fidelity. Together, these components improve training efficiency and rendering performance for large scenes. We also introduce a large-scale underwater dataset covering diverse marine environments. Experiments on five large-scale scenes demonstrate favorable scalability, compactness, and efficiency--quality trade-offs over large-scene baselines. Controlled comparisons on the small-scale SeaThru-NeRF dataset further show competitive reconstruction quality with substantially smaller model sizes than underwater-specific methods.

articles.title_zh: OceanXL:通过块分割和适应性推跑实现的大型水下高斯平板
articles.content_zh: 水下三维重建对于海洋勘探、生态监测和海底基础设施检查至关重要,但由于光衰减、散射和捕获范围有限,在大规模上仍然具有挑战性。 虽然3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)可以实现高质量的实时渲染,但其在大型水下场景中的应用却受到内存消耗高和在大面积上优化效率低下的限制. 我们提出OceanXL,这是一个快速而可扩展的基于3DGS的大规模水下重建框架. OceanXL采用分而相之的策略,将场景分割成空间相通的块来进行高效优化,同时保持全球几何相通. 我们进一步推行适应性探险计划,以适应水下条件,去除多余的原始人,产生紧凑的表示而不会牺牲视觉上的忠诚. 这些组成部分共同提高大场景的培训效率和渲染性能. 我们还采用了涵盖各种海洋环境的大规模水下数据集。 5个大型场景的实验显示,相对于大场地基线而言,具有有利的可伸缩性、紧凑性和效率质量取舍。 对小型 " 海图 -- -- NERF " 数据集进行有控制的比较,进一步显示具有竞争力的重建质量,模型尺寸大大小于水下特定方法。

articles.title: ADATEX4D: adaptive texture capacity allocation for 4D gaussian splatting
articles.content: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA triplanes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ADATEX4D:4D Gaussian电镀的适应性纹理能力分配
articles.content_zh: 纹理高斯人提高了当地的外观能力,但将同样的纹理分辨率分配给了在低细节或低能见度地区储存的每一个原始废物. 我们引入了AdaTex4D,一个适应性的纹理容量模块,用于基于变形的4D高斯平板. 每个高斯人携带已打包的RGBA出行图,其两轴会根据能见度正常化的屏幕-空间梯度和变形的局部尺度独立生长. N3DV和PanopticSports上的实验显示,AdaTex4D在保存重建质量的同时将纹理存储量减少了一半以上. 在固定的内存预算下,适应性分配也比统一的纹理分配提高了质量并减少了整体模型和峰值内存. 这些结果显示,动态的,异相的纹理分配为在4D高斯代表物中分配出本地外观能力提供了更有效的方式.

articles.title: Not All Confusion Is Equal: A Source-Aware Uncertainty Diagnosis for Fine-Grained Aircraft Detection
articles.content: Fine-grained object detectors are commonly evaluated with confusion matrices, which show where the model is confused but not why, nor whether the confusion can be reduced. We argue that confusion can be attributed to distinct, separable sources, each quantitatively measurable, turning a passive measurement into actionable guidance. We present $A^2E^2$, a diagnostic tool that decomposes the sources of confusion along two axes, $\{$aleatoric, epistemic$\} \times \{$within-class, between-class$\}$, giving a $2\times2$ taxonomy that enumerates the source types. Each quadrant is measured by its own quantity, computed in one of three places (input geometry, output-space disagreement, and the bias-parameter posterior), so the two epistemic sources are separated by construction rather than by an empirical correlation. On fine-grained aircraft detection, the four quadrants become four named sources with their own remedy verdict: affinity (geometric similarity, irreducible from size alone), heterogeneity (geometrically heterogeneous sub-variants, pointing to re-labeling rather than more data), contested (an insufficiently trained but learnable boundary, improvable), and collapsed (a class starved of data, reducible). After attributing the confusion to a specific reducible source, we apply a targeted intervention and verify experimentally that it reduces the diagnosed source specifically while leaving the irreducible sources unchanged. $A^2E^2$ thus turns confusion measurement into a concrete, validatable and actionable "diagnosis" in which the same off-diagonal mass can carry opposite causes and opposite remedies. We also state this framework's limits, including which sources are only partially identifiable on this specific dataset and why.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 并非所有困惑都是平等的:精细识别飞机检测的源码不确定诊断
articles.content_zh: 细纹物体探测器通常用混淆矩阵来评价,显示模型在哪里被混淆,但不能说明原因,也不能减少混淆. 我们主张,混淆可归因于不同的、可分离的源头,每个源头在数量上可以衡量,将被动的衡量转化为可操作的指导。 我们提出 $A^2E^2$, 一种诊断工具, 分解混淆源 沿着两轴, $$$aleatoric, 缩略语$\tims$\tims $ 在班内, $-$-$之间, 给出一个 $2\tims2$ 的分类学, 列出源类型 。 每个象限由自身数量来测量,计算在三个地方之一(输入几何,输出-空间差异,和偏差-参数后方),因此这两个相感源通过构造而不是经验相关性来分离. 在精细的飞机探测上,这四个四象限成为了四个命名来源,它们有自己的补救判断:亲和性(几何相似性,仅从尺寸上是无法减少的),异质性(几何相异的分变量,指重贴标签,而不是更多的数据),有争议的(训练不足但可学习的边界,即兴可变),并倒塌了(一个阶级缺数据,可减少数据). 在将混乱归因于具体的可减少来源之后,我们采取有针对性的干预措施,并实验性地核实它具体减少了确诊来源,同时使不可减少来源保持不变。 因此,$A^2E^2美元将混沌度量转化为具体、可验证和可操作的“诊断”,在这种诊断中,相同的非对角质量可以带有相反的原因和相反的补救措施。 我们还说明了这个框架的限度,包括在这个具体数据集上只能部分识别哪些来源和原因。

articles.title: Mind What Matters for Reasoning: Aligning Cross-Modal Attention via Selective Probability Mass Concentration
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning tasks, yet remain prone to hallucinations and over-reliance on language priors, often generating answers without adequately using task-relevant visual evidence. Existing approaches primarily improve reasoning through reasoning-oriented supervision or inference-time strategies. In this work, we study a complementary question: can multimodal reasoning be improved by strengthening implicit visual grounding without directly supervising the reasoning process? Motivated by the functional specialization of attention heads, we investigate whether reasoning can be improved by guiding only the heads most responsive to visual evidence grounding. We propose Selective Probability Mass Concentration (sPMC), a training framework that identifies grounding-responsive heads and selectively regularizes their text-to-image attention. sPMC treats normalized attention over visual tokens as a spatial probability distribution and encourages the probability mass to be assigned to semantically relevant regions using segmentation-derived spatial priors. Adaptive Head Selection restricts this guidance to visually responsive heads while leaving the remaining heads unconstrained to preserve their complementary functions. Across 6 multimodal benchmark suites, sPMC achieves an average zero-shot improvement of 3% and gains of up to 11.3% across multiple MLLMs while regularizing only 3%-15% of their attention heads. These results demonstrate that targeted guidance of sparse and implicit visual evidence pathways can directly improve multimodal reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 注意什么是理性的要务:通过选择性概率质量浓度调整跨模式的注意力
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理任务上取得了强大的性能,然而仍然容易产生幻觉并过度依赖语言前传,往往产生答案而未充分使用与任务相关的视觉证据. 现有方法主要通过注重推理的监督或推断时间战略来改进推理. 在这项工作中,我们研究了一个互补的问题:能否通过加强隐含的视觉基础而不直接监督推理过程来改进多式联运推理? 由于注意力头的功能专业化,我们调查是否可以通过指导那些对视觉证据基础反应最迅速的人来改进推理。 我们提出选择性概率质量集中(spMC),这是一个培训框架,它确定地面响应头并有选择地规范其文字到图像的注意力。 SPMC将常态化的对视觉信号的注意作为空间概率分布,并鼓励利用分化产生的空间前兆,将概率质量分配给相关区域。 适应性头部选择将本取向限制在视效头部,而使其余头部不受限制,以保持其互补功能. 在6个多模式基准套件中,SPMC平均实现3%的零镜头改进,在多个MLLM中实现高达11.3%的增益,而只规范了3%-15%的注意力头. 这些结果表明,有针对性地指导稀少和隐含的视觉证据路径可直接改善多式联运推理。

articles.title: Beyond Spatial Benchmarks: From Spatial Reasoning to Navigation
articles.content: Does progress on spatial reasoning benchmarks translate into better navigation? Existing benchmarks test isolated inferences from images or videos, with little connection to downstream navigation. Our analysis reveals a gap between benchmark-oriented spatial specialization and navigation performance, and shows how aligning spatial supervision with navigation goals, phases, and decision learning improves navigation. Guided by these findings, we build \textsc{Spatial-Nav-100K} and fine-tune in two stages, \textit{i.e.} first learning a shared spatial-navigation foundation, and then specializing each phase with the abilities it relies on. We further introduce Spatial-NPD, where a teacher conditioned on spatial priors produces grounded action preferences and distills them into a student policy, so no explicit spatial reasoning is needed at inference. With 45 A100 GPU-hours of policy training, our 8B model reaches SR/SPL of 77.4/35.4 on HM3D-v0.2, 60.2/30.5 on HM3D-v0.1, and 47.9/20.6 on train-unseen MP3D. It outperforms several systems that rely on closed-source models or thousands of GPU-hours of training, at 148 ms per action step. All code and datasets will be publicly available at https://github.com/ylwhxht/Spatial-Nav.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越空间 基准: 从空间原因到导航
articles.content_zh: 空间推理基准方面的进展是否转化为更好的导航? 现有基准测试从图像或视频中孤立的推论,与下游导航几乎没有联系. 我们的分析显示,面向基准的空间专业化与导航性能之间存在差距,并表明空间监督如何与导航目标、阶段和决策学习保持一致,从而改善导航。 在这些发现的指引下,我们构建\textsc{Spatial-Nav-100K}并分两个阶段进行微调,\textit{i.e.}首先学习一个共享的空间导航基础,然后用它所依赖的能力专门每个阶段. 我们进一步引入了Space-NPD,其中以空间前科为条件的教师产生有底线的动作偏好,并将其提炼成学生政策,因此在推论上不需要明确的空间推理. 通过45个A100GPU小时的政策培训,我们的8B型号在HM3D-v0.2上达到SR/SPL77.4/35.4,在HM3D-v0.1上达到60.2/30.5,在列车未见的MP3D上达到47.9/20.6. 它超越了几个依赖于闭源模型或数千GPU小时训练的系统,每个动作步骤148ms. 所有代码和数据集将在https://github.com/ylwhxht/Spatial-Nav上公开查阅。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of VLM Pipelines for Long-Document QA
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for long-document processing, where the inputs combine text with charts, tables, figures, and complex layouts. Deploying them means choosing how to feed the document to the model, which retriever to use when only a subset of pages is sent, and whether to run the model agentically or as a static pipeline. We study these choices on two long-document QA benchmarks with both frontier API and open-weight VLMs. First, on MMLongBench-Doc our six-tool agent with page, table, figure, and search calls pays off only once the answering VLM is large enough: with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B it trails static page input, with Qwen3.5-27B it draws level, and with Sonnet 4.5 it leads. On LongDocURL it is level with or ahead of static input at every reader. Its lead over the strongest static pipeline is clearest with the frontier reader on MMLongBench-Doc and narrows to within noise on LongDocURL. Second, retrieval modality matters more than the specific retriever: the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline, and on the text side a single off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank essentially matches a much heavier multi-stage LLM pipeline. Top-k image retrieval is also the most token-efficient input at every reader we paired it with, at roughly a seventh to a quarter of the tokens of sending every page. Third, cutting across all three choices, three of our strongest pipelines succeed on different questions, and an oracle that picks the best pipeline per question gains roughly thirteen points over the best single pipeline, though evidence-type routing recovers almost none of it.

articles.title_zh: 关于用于长文件QA的VLM管道的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言模型(VLMs)越来越多地用于长文档处理,其中输入内容结合了文本与图表,图表,数字,以及复杂的布局. 部署它们意味着选择如何将文档输入模型,当只发送一个子集的页面时,该模型将检索器使用,是用代理方式运行模型还是作为静态管道运行. 我们用两个长文件质量评估基准来研究这些选择,这些基准既有前沿API,也有开放式VLM。 首先,在MMLong Bench-Doc上,我们的六工具代理,有页,表,图,搜索呼叫只有在回答的VLM足够大后才能支付:用Quen3.5-4B和9B跟踪静态页面输入,用Quen3.5-27B绘制关卡,用Sonnet4.5引导. 在LongDocURL上,它与每个读取器的静态输入或比静态输入还早。 它在最坚固的静态管道上的引力与MMLong Bench-Doc上的前沿阅读器最为清晰,并缩小到LongDocURL上的噪声内. 第二,检索方式比具体的检索器更重要:最强图像检索器领导最强文本管道,在文本侧面,一个现成的交叉编码器重新排位基本上与重得多的多级LLM管道匹配. 顶端-k图像检索也是我们配对的每个阅读器中最有符号效率的输入,大约是发送每页的符号的第七到四分之一. 第三,跨越所有三个选择,我们三个最强的管道在不同的问题上取得成功,一个选择每个问题最好的管道的神谕比最好的单一管道获得大约13分,尽管证据类型的路线几乎没有恢复。

articles.title: It's the Geometry, Not the Model: Effective Rank and Subspace Alignment in Functional Connectivity Classification
articles.content: Resting-state functional connectivity (FC) is widely used to classify brain phenotypes and disorders. Most pipelines use the full connectome and seek gains through model design. We instead examine how FC geometry constrains classification and cross-site transfer. Across-subject FC variation concentrates in a small effective subspace, suggesting substantial redundancy in nominal dimensions. Across cohorts, these subspaces may differ in orientation even when their effective ranks are comparable, potentially limiting transfer. Across 2,330 subjects from HCP, ABIDE, and ADHD-200, effective-rank analysis reveals strong spectral concentration. Projection onto leading components at the effective-rank scale recovers most of the full-FC classification performance. In ABIDE, site-specific effective subspaces are weakly aligned, and their principal-angle overlap predicts pairwise transfer after covariate adjustment despite comparable per-site effective ranks. Controlled rotations that alter subspace orientation while preserving the mean and covariance spectrum drive transfer toward chance, whereas displacement-matched label-orthogonal rotations do not. These results identify subspace orientation as a key factor in transfer degradation under controlled perturbations. This study offers a geometric diagnostic of FC generalization and suggests evaluating cross-site harmonization by its ability to align effective subspaces alongside classification accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 这是几何学,不是模型:功能连接分类的有效排名和亚空间对齐
articles.content_zh: 休眠状态功能连接(FC)被广泛用于脑酚类和紊乱分类. 大多数管道使用全连接器,并通过模型设计寻求收益. 相反,我们审查FC几何如何限制分类和跨地点转移。 跨主题的FC变异集中在一个小的有效的子空间,表明名义维度有很大的冗余. 在各个组别中,这些子空间的定向可能有所不同,即使其有效级别是可比的,有可能限制转移。 在HCP、ABIDE和ADHD-200的2,330个课题中,有效的排名分析显示光谱浓度很高。 在有效排名尺度上投射到主要成分,恢复了大部分全FC分类性能. 在ABIDE中,站点特定有效子空间的对齐性很弱,其主角重叠预测,尽管每个站点有效排位相当,但共变调整后会成对转移. 控制旋转改变子空间方向,同时保持平均和共变频谱向机会转移,而移位匹配的标签正向旋转则不进行。 这些结果将亚空间导向确定为在受控扰动下转移降解的一个关键因素。 这项研究对FC的概括性进行了几何诊断,建议通过能够将有效的子空间与分类精度结合起来来评价跨地点的统一性。

articles.title: EndoFSA: Endoscopic Few-Shot Image Generation via Rank-Constrained Parameter Adaptation
articles.content: WCE produces large-scale gastrointestinal image data yet pathological findings remain significantly underrepresented limiting the generalization performance of deep-learning based abnormality detection systems. SDG methods offer a practical solution to mitigate this imbalance. However their training directly on scarce abnormal samples often results in instability overfitting and structural distortions. Addressing these challenges requires controlled adaptation mechanisms that preserve anatomical priors while enabling realistic pathological variation. This paper presents EndoFSA a GAN-based model for Endoscopic Few-Shot image generation by Adaptation in WCE imaging. EndoFSA leverages a generator pretrained on abundant normal data and adapts it to abnormal domains using limited number of training samples through a rank-constrained parameter adaptation where only a small number of modulation parameters is updated while the pretrained weights remain frozen. By restricting parameter updates to a low dimensional subspace and incorporating perceptual boundary regularization and cluster-wise diversity control EndoFSA enables efficient model adaptation under limited data conditions and mitigates mode collapse while preserving the anatomical priors learned from normal data. Importantly EndoFSA operates without requiring pixel-level annotations, masks or bounding box supervision. Evaluation on publicly available WCE benchmark datasets spanning various abnormal categories demonstrates that EndoFSA generates abnormal images reproducing real lesions morphology. Moreover in a downstream classification task training an image classifier solely on synthetic abnormal images generated by EndoFSA yields performance comparable to that obtained with real images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EndoFSA:通过Rank-Control参数调整产生外观的少热图像
articles.content_zh: WCE生成大规模胃肠影像数据,但病理学发现仍然严重不足,限制了基于深层学习的异常检测系统的一般化性能。 可持续发展目标方法为缓解这种不平衡提供了一个切实可行的解决办法。 然而,他们直接接受关于稀有异常样本的培训,往往导致不稳定性过度适应和结构扭曲。 应对这些挑战需要控制下的适应机制,这种机制既能保存解剖前科,又能促成现实的病理变化。 本文介绍了一种基于全球网络的模型,即通过WCE成像中的适应生成EndoFSA。 EndoFSA利用一个在丰富的正常数据上预先训练的生成器,通过级限制参数的调整使其适应使用有限数量的训练样本的异常域,其中仅更新了少量的调制参数,同时预先训练的重量仍然冻结. 通过将参数更新限制在低维子空间,并纳入感知边界规范化和集群多样性控制 EndoFSA 使得在有限的数据条件下高效的模型适应,并减轻模式崩溃,同时保留从正常数据中吸取的解剖学前科. 重要的是,EndoFSA的运作不需要像素级别说明、口罩或边框监督。 对可公开获取的涵盖各种异常类别的WCE基准数据集的评价表明,EndoFSA产生反常图像,再现真实损伤形态. 此外,在下游的分类任务中,一个图像分类器完全根据远东金融行动管理局生成的合成异常图像进行,其性能与真实图像的性能相当。

articles.title: When Can Agents Forget Their Reasoning? ICLR for Long-Horizon Agent Context Compression
articles.content: Long horizon language model agents continually accumulate reasoning history, increasing context length and inference cost even after earlier decisions have been executed and observed. Unlike static Chain of Thought compression, removing historical reasoning can change future actions and the resulting interaction trajectory. We study when such reasoning can be safely forgotten. We propose Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning (ICLR), a training free online method that ranks reasoning blocks using frozen proxy entropy while preserving actions, tool calls, and observations. On 260 WorkBuddyBench tasks, ICLR improves average reward from 0.699 to 0.718, while reducing input, output, and cache read tokens by 25.5%, 14.4%, and 33.3%, respectively. Ablations reveal trajectory amplification, where local reasoning deletion produces nonlinear changes in total computation by altering subsequent interaction. Representation probing, activation patching, and controlled trajectory analyses further suggest that historical reasoning becomes more replaceable once task relevant derived state has been reliably externalized into code, files, tool outputs, or environmental feedback. These results characterize agent reasoning as dynamic working state rather than permanent interaction history.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 特工们何时能忘记他们的理性? 长视线代理上下文压缩的ICLR
articles.content_zh: 长视野语言模型代理人不断积累推理历史,即使在先前的决定得到执行和观察之后,也增加了上下文长度和推论成本. 与静态的思维压缩链不同,删除历史推理可以改变未来的动作和由此产生的相互作用轨迹. 我们研究何时可以安全地忘记这种推理。 我们提出“互动感知抑制长视野理性”(ICLR), 这是一种免费的在线培训方法, 在260个WorkBuddy Bench任务上,ICLR将平均奖励从0.699提高到0.718,同时将输入,输出和缓存读取符分别减少25.5%,14.4%和33.3%. 缩放揭示了轨迹放大,其中局部推理删除通过改变后续的相互作用在总计算中产生非线性变化. 表现探测、激活补丁和控制轨迹分析进一步表明,一旦相关任务衍生状态可靠地外部化为代码、文件、工具输出或环境反馈,历史推理就更容易被取代。 这些成果将代理人推理定性为动态工作状态而非永久互动历史.

articles.title: Efficient Continuous DEM Reconstruction under Limited Target-Resolution Supervision
articles.content: High-resolution digital elevation models (DEMs) support Earth observation applications, but paired training references are often available only at coarser output resolutions. Reconstructing finer terrain grids therefore requires both effective transfer beyond the supervised scale and control of dense-query computation. To address this problem, SCOPE learns a continuous terrain representation from coarser-resolution pairs. It predicts a latent coefficient field on the low-resolution grid and reuses local Fourier residual functions through basis evaluation and geometry-guided ensemble fusion. This separates high-dimensional coefficient prediction from output-grid construction. Experiments on geographically distributed land--ocean samples assess supervised reconstruction, unseen-scale inference, cross-domain generalization, and theoretical computation. SCOPE leads the compared methods across six metrics in the main supervised-scale evaluation. At an unseen factor three times the training factor, land reconstruction reduces RMSE and MAE by approximately 12\% relative to bicubic interpolation, with errors close to target-scale fine-tuning. Ninefold output density increases counted multiply--accumulate operations by only about 2\%. Frozen-model validation on held-out external marine regions reduces RMSE relative to the DEM-specific implicit baseline EBCF-CDEM by approximately 19\% under self-downsampling and 2\% with cross-product inputs, while also yielding lower RMSE than LIIF-MS in both settings. These results demonstrate the value of reusable coefficient fields for accurate reconstruction beyond the supervised resolution with low incremental arithmetic cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效连续德国马克 目标决议有限监督下的重建
articles.content_zh: 高分辨率数字高程模型(DEMs)支持对地观测应用,但配对培训参考材料往往只在较短的输出分辨率中提供。 因此,要重建更细的地形网,就需要在有监督的尺度之外进行有效的转移,还需要控制密集的热量计算。 为了解决这一问题,SCOPE从较近分辨率的对子中学习到连续的地形代表. 它预测低分辨率网格上的潜在系数场,并通过基础评价和几何制导的聚变再利用当地的傅里叶残留功能. 这把高维系数预测与输出-网格构造分开. 对地理分布的陆地 -- -- 海洋样品进行实验,评估有监督的重建、未见规模的推论、跨域归纳和理论计算。 在主要监督规模评价中,SCOPE在6个衡量标准上牵头采用比较方法。 土地重建使RMSE和MAE比双立体插值减少约12%,误差接近目标规模的微调。 输出密度增加9倍,计算乘积操作仅约2\%. 对搁置的外部海洋区域的冷冻模型验证将RMSE相对于DEM特定隐含基线EBCF-CDEM减少约19\%,在自下采样下减少2\%,在两种情况下,RMSE也比LIIF-MS低。 这些结果表明,在经过监督的解析之后,可重新使用的系数字段对于准确重建的价值低。

articles.title: Modelling dynamic systems transfer functions from events in computational neuromorphic imaging
articles.content: Event Vision Sensing (EVS) report threshold crossings of log-irradiance, so a static optical system imaging a static scene produces no output at all. The classical procedure for measuring a Point Spread Function (PSF), illuminating the system with a constant point source, therefore has no event-based equivalent: the probe must carry a temporal profile, and that profile becomes part of the measurement. A growing body of Computational Neuromorphic Imaging (CNI) work already exploits this, pairing engineered or modulated optics with event sensing, but each system adopts a particular excitation together with a particular reading of the event stream without the correspondence between the two being stated. We examine that correspondence directly within a analytical framework of an Linear Shift-Invariant (LSI) optical system with a specified Modulation Transfer Function (MTF), a first-order filter EVS pixel model, and three different temporal probes: a step function, a linear ramp and an exponential ramp. By analysing the inverse of the entire chain for different event-statistic, and comparing the results to the specified MTF, we identify the context where each probe is most relevant. We consider how photon-noise and cross-array threshold mismatch effects the analytical accuracy of the probe-inverse. Results show that the widely used step probe is highly susceptible to mismatch while resilient to photon shot-noise, while a linear rise probe and exponential rise probe retain their ability to infer signal levels even with high mismatch. We discuss the potential of dynamic-PSFs as components of a full forward operator from scene to events. In this, we use this analytical description to define dynamic-PSFs around EVS, and discuss the gaps toward a unified pixel model and a scene-composition framework required for CNI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 根据计算神经形态成像中的事件模拟动态系统转移功能
articles.content_zh: Event Visualension(EVS)报告对数辐射的阈值交叉,因此静态光学系统成像一个静态场景完全不产生输出. 测量一个点散射函数(PSF)的古典程序,用恒定点源来显示系统,因此没有基于事件的等效程序:探测器必须带有时间剖面,该剖面成为测量的一部分. 不断增长的计算神经形态成像(CNI)工作已经利用了这个,将工程或调制的光学与事件感知配对,但每个系统都采用特定的激发法,同时对事件流进行特定的读取,而没有说明两者之间的对应关系。 我们直接在一个分析框架内审查这种对应关系,一个线性转移-Invariant(LSI)光学系统,它具有一个特定的模块转移函数(MTF),一个一阶滤波器EVS像素模型,以及三个不同的时间探测器:一个步骤函数,一个线性坡道和一个指数坡道。 通过分析不同事件统计学的整个链条的反向,并将结果与指定的多边信托基金进行比较,我们确定每个探测器最相关的背景。 我们考虑光噪声和跨阵列阈值不匹配如何影响探测反向的分析准确性。 结果显示,广泛使用的步调探测器在抗光射噪的同时极易发生错配,而线性升降探测器和指数升降探测器即使在高错配的情况下仍保留推断信号水平的能力. 我们讨论动态-PSF作为从现场到事件的全前方操作员的组成部分的潜力。 在此,我们用这个分析描述来定义EVS周围的动态-PSF,并讨论向一个统一的像素模型和CNI所需的场景组合框架的缺口.

articles.title: BeyondRetarget: Learning Executable Humanoid Motions Directly from Monocular Video
articles.content: Learning executable motions from human videos offers a scalable solution for humanoid robots to acquire demonstration motions. However, existing pipelines typically first construct an explicit human motion representation and then convert it into robot motions via motion retargeting. Although such methods can effectively leverage large volumes of existing human data for training, the substantial differences between humans and humanoid robots in locomotion mechanisms and joint degree-of-freedom configurations make motions generated by this human-representation-centric approach difficult to execute on robots. Furthermore, errors introduced during human motion estimation inevitably propagate to the retargeting stage and cannot be eliminated via joint optimization. We propose BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that directly maps monocular RGB videos to robot motions. Discarding the explicit human representation, this framework learns robot-oriented implicit representations directly from visual observations, enabling the model to capture cross-morphology motion structures. To generate motions more suitable for robot execution, we further design a contact-aware motion optimization mechanism to improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility. Experiments show that BeyondRetarget significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of generated robot motions, while achieving higher execution success rates and lower latency in both simulation environments and real humanoid robots.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Retarget: 直接从单曲视频学习可执行的人体动作
articles.content_zh: 从人体视频中学习可执行的运动,为人体机器人获得演示运动提供了可伸缩的解决方案. 然而,现有的管道一般首先构建一种明确的人类运动表现,然后通过运动重定向将其转化为机器人运动. 虽然这些方法可以有效地利用大量现有的人类数据进行培训,但人类和人造机器人在运动机制和联合自由度配置方面的巨大差异,使得这种以人代表为中心的方法所产生的运动难以在机器人身上执行. 此外,人类运动估计过程中出现的错误不可避免地传播到重新瞄准阶段,无法通过联合优化消除。 我们提议BeyondReoctarget,一个端到端的框架,直接将单光的RGB视频映射到机器人运动中. 这个框架抛弃了明显的人类表现,直接从视觉观测中学习到面向机器人的隐含表现,使模型能够捕捉到跨形态运动结构. 为了产生更适合机器人执行的运动,我们进一步设计了一种接触感运动优化机制,以提高时间一致性和物理可信度. 实验显示,BeyondReoctarge大大提高了生成的机器人运动的精度和稳健性,同时在模拟环境和真人机器人中都实现了更高的执行成功率和较低的耐久性.

articles.title: SplatLabel: Pseudo-Labelling through 4D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: While 2D Vision Foundation Models offer a pathway to automate 3D semantic pseudo-labelling, translating these priors into robust 3D representations typically requires complex heuristics or multi-model ensembles. We introduce SplatLabel, an automated pipeline that leverages a 4D Gaussian representation to extract LiDAR segmentation with predictive confidence, as well as semantic occupancy grids at arbitrary voxel resolutions. At its core, SplatLabel handles dynamic environments through an explicit temporal manifold that models the trajectories and lifespans of individual 3D primitives. This allows the system to accurately track moving actors and strictly define when objects appear and disappear, completely eliminating the need for pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes. To robustly support this dynamic tracking, the representation is grounded by structural and semantic priors: we guide scene geometry in unobserved regions by integrating 360-degree LiDAR via virtual depth maps, and rather than relying on domain-specific prompt engineering, we directly distill continuous soft probabilities from 2D models to inherently resolve semantic ambiguities over time and space. Finally, to accurately reflect the real-world trade-off between precision and recall, we reframe pseudo-label evaluation as a selective classification task using a generalized risk-recall metric. Experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that SplatLabel consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple recall levels, establishing a highly robust framework for both 3D LiDAR segmentation and occupancy prediction.

articles.title_zh: SplatLabel:通过 4D 高斯滑板的 Pseudo-Labelling
articles.content_zh: 虽然2D展望基金会 模型提供了将3D语义伪标签自动化的路径,将这些前缀转换成强力的3D表示通常需要复杂的heuristic或多模型的组合. 我们引入了SplatLabel, 一种自动管道, 它利用一个4D高斯代表 以预测的置信度提取LiDAR分化, 以及语义占用网 任意的 voxel 分辨率。 其核心是SplatLabel通过一个明确的时间倍数处理动态环境,模拟单个3D原始生物的轨迹和寿命. 这使得系统能够准确跟踪移动的演员,并严格定义物体何时出现和消失,完全消除了预先附加说明的3D边框的需要. 为了有力地支持这种动态跟踪,该表现以结构学和语义学前科为基础:我们通过虚拟深度图将360度的LiDAR集成,引导未观测区域的场景几何,而不是依赖特定域的即时工程,直接从2D模型中提炼出连续的软概率,从时间和空间中自然地解决语义上的模糊. 最后,为了准确地反映准确性和回顾性之间的现实世界权衡,我们重新界定了假标签评价是一项选择性的分类任务,使用一个一般性的风险回顾指标。 关于语义学KITTI的实验表明,SplatLabel在多个召回水平上一贯超过最先进的基线,为3D LiDAR分区和占用率预测建立了非常有力的框架。

articles.title: Retrieve-to-Localize: Bridging Large Language Models and LiDAR Geometry for Spatial Grounding
articles.content: LiDAR provides precise geometric information for spatial perception tasks such as object detection in autonomous driving and outdoor robotics. However, recognizing and localizing individual objects is not sufficient to answer questions that require composing spatial relations and grounding the intended target. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for autonomous driving, we leverage their language priors to interpret complex spatial questions and ground the referred target in LiDAR geometry. To support this spatial grounding capability, we introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA, which combines single- and multi-step relational grounding with complementary spatial understanding tasks. We further propose SpatialLiDAR-LM, which aligns LiDAR point features with an LLM and grounds target coordinates through language-conditioned, position-aware proposal retrieval and local point refinement. This design derives target coordinates directly from local LiDAR geometry rather than through textual language decoding. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over representative LiDAR--language models and multi-camera VLMs on precise coordinate prediction tasks. Our dataset and model training code will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: 检索到本地化:连接大语言模型和LiDAR空间地面几何
articles.content_zh: LiDAR为空间感知任务提供精确的几何信息,如自主驾驶和室外机器人中的物体探测. 然而,单个物体的识别和定位不足以回答需要形成空间关系和使预定目标搁浅的问题。 在最近大语言模型(LLMs)自主驱动的推动下,我们利用他们的语言前身来解释复杂的空间问题,并将LiDAR几何学中被提及的目标定位. 为了支持这种空间定位能力,我们引入了SpaceLiDAR-QA,将单步和多步的关系定位与互补的空间理解任务结合起来. 我们进一步提出SpaceLiDAR-LM,通过语言条件、位置意识建议检索和局部点改进,将LiDAR点特征与LLM和地面目标坐标相协调。 这种设计直接从本地的LiDAR几何中获取目标坐标,而不是通过文字语言解码. 实验表明,与具有代表性的LiDAR语言模型和精确坐标预测任务的多相机VLM相比,已有重大改进。 我们的数据集和模型训练代码将公开发布.

articles.title: Anatomy-Aligned Surface Field Learning for Myocardial Reconstruction from Sparse Short-Axis Cine MRI
articles.content: Patient-specific 4D myocardial reconstruction from cine MRI supports quantitative functional assessment, regional motion analysis, and simulation-based modeling. However, routinely acquired short-axis (SAX) cine MRI is sparsely sampled along the through-plane direction, making dense and anatomically consistent surface reconstruction challenging. In this study, we propose an anatomy-aligned surface learning framework that parameterizes the epicardial and endocardial surfaces on a shared circumferential-longitudinal UV domain. This formulation converts irregular 3D reconstruction into structured coordinate-field completion with explicit correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases. Sparse SAX contours are encoded as UV observation fields, coverage-aware sampling improves robustness to incomplete slice coverage, and topology- and distortion-aware learning preserves circumferential continuity and local surface quality. Experiments on three public cine MRI datasets showed that the proposed method consistently outperformed representative mesh-based and implicit reconstruction approaches, achieving overall Chamfer distances of $2.887$~mm on ACDC, $2.641$~mm on M\&Ms, and $2.810$~mm on M\&Ms-2. The reconstructed sequences also preserved ventricular function, with end-diastolic volume and ejection fraction errors of $3.3$~mL and $1.1 \%$, respectively. These results demonstrate that anatomy-aligned UV learning provides an accurate, efficient, and correspondence-aware representation for sparse cine MRI reconstruction and myocardial modeling. The source code will be available at https://github.com/yuan-xiaohan/SAX2MyoSurf.

articles.title_zh: 从Sparse短轴磁共振磁共振中为心肌重建学习解剖学-相容表面场
articles.content_zh: 由cine核磁共振产生的患者特异性的4D心肌重建支持定量功能评估,区域运动分析,以及模拟模型. 然而,通常得到的短轴(SAX)燃烧核磁共振在通过飞机方向上很少采样,使密集的、在解剖学上一致的表面重建具有挑战性。 在这项研究中,我们提出一个解剖学与表层结合的学习框架,将心动和心内膜表面参数化在一个共享的环-纵向紫外线域上. 这种配方将不规则的立体重建转化为结构化的坐标-场完成,并明确对应主体和心脏阶段. Sparse SAX轮廓被编码为紫外线观测场,覆盖意识采样将坚固度提升到不完整的片面覆盖,地形学和扭曲意识学习保持了环绕连续性和当地表面质量. 对三个公共焚烧磁共振数据集的试验表明,拟议方法的效绩始终高于具有代表性的基于网格和隐含的重建方法,使化学剂总距离达到非洲催化中心2.887美元~毫米,MQMMs为2.641美元~毫米,MXM-2为2.810美元~毫米。 重建的序列还保留了通风功能,末端射流体积和喷射分数错误分别为3.3美元~mL和1.1美元~$. 这些结果表明,解剖学与紫外线结合的学习为稀薄的焚化核磁共振重建和心肌建模提供了准确、高效和具有对应意识的表述。 该源代码可在https://github.com/yuan-xiaohan/SAX2MyoSurf上查阅.

articles.title: AV-GRPO: Modality-Anchored Decoupling Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Joint Audio-Video Generation
articles.content: Recent years have witnessed major progress in joint audio-video generation. Existing models still suffer from limited per-modality fidelity, insufficient text-modality alignment and weak cross-modal synchronization. While reinforcement-learning post-training offers a promising remedy, directly adapting it to joint audio-video generation is challenging. Heterogeneous multimodal rewards entangle learning signals and complicate credit assignment. Joint optimization of two modality towers is computationally expensive given their divergent dynamics. Moreover, synchronization evaluation difficulty depends on paired samples, preventing fair reward comparisons. We propose AV-GRPO, a modality-anchored online diffusion RL framework, and 5DAV, a decoupled, difficulty-controllable training dataset. AV-GRPO includes three key modules: (1) modality-anchored rollouts to disentangle learning signals and stabilize difficulty; (2) trajectory-locked frozen-tower optimization to reduce cost and reassign credit; (3) adaptive objectives and perturbation strengths tailored to modality-specific dynamics. This converts coupled multimodal preference learning into unimodal subproblems for precise reward attribution and better synchronization. Our 5DAV dataset decouples samples across five dimensions for systematic training. Experiments on JavisBench and VABench demonstrate AV-GRPO outperforms LTX-2.3 in generation quality, semantic alignment and cross-modal synchronization under LoRA and full fine-tuning. Ablations confirm our designs. Code and data: https://github.com/zhiyuxu03/AV-GRPO
