articles.title_zh: AV-GRPO:为联合视听节目制作而加强教学
articles.content_zh: 近年来,在联合制作音频视频方面取得了重大进展。 现有的模式仍然受到每个模式的忠诚度有限、文本模式不统一和跨模式同步性薄弱的影响。 虽然加强学习后培训提供了有希望的补救办法,但直接使其适应联合音频视频生成是一项挑战。 异质的多式联运奖励缠绕学习信号,使信用分配复杂化. 由于两个模式塔的动态不同,它们联合优化计算成本很高。 此外,同步评价难度取决于配对样本,阻碍了公平奖励比较. 我们提出AV-GRPO,一个模式化的在线传播RL框架,以及5DAV,一个脱钩的,难以控制的训练数据集. AV-GRPO包括三个关键模块:(1) 模式驱动的推出,以分散学习信号和稳定难度;(2) 轨迹锁定的冷冻托盘优化,以降低成本和重新分配信用;(3) 适应目标和适应模式特定动态的扰动优势。 这把结合的多式联运优惠学习转化为单一模式次问题,以便精确地奖励归属和更好地同步。 我们的5DAV数据集 脱钩样本 跨越五个维度 系统培训。 在Javis Bench和VA Bench上的实验显示,在LORA和全微调下,AV-GRPO在生成质量,语义对齐和跨模式同步方面都超过了LTX-2.3. 过失证实了我们的设计。 代码和数据:https://github.com/zhiyuxu03/AV-GRPO

articles.title: S2Planner: Multi-Scale Semantic Planner for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
articles.content: We present S2Planner, a trajectory planner that combines three front-facing cameras with ego-motion history and the current driving command. A fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone and a Spatial Tuning Adapter produce multi-scale image features; a coarse-to-fine decoder then uses trajectory self-attention and camera-projected cross-attention to refine candidate waypoints. The contribution is the integration of ego-conditioned trajectory initialization with iterative, geometry-guided sampling of multi-scale image features, rather than a new visual backbone or attention operator. On the NAVSIM v1 non-reactive evaluation, the previously reported navtest run obtained 88.03 PDMS. Because that run was selected using navtest performance, this number is exploratory and cannot be interpreted as an unbiased test estimate. Validation-selected evaluation on unexposed data, repeated runs, and computational measurements are needed to establish generalization and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: S2规划员:端到端自主驾驶的多比例语义规划员
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍S2Planner, 一个轨迹规划师, 结合三台前置相机 与自我运动的历史和目前的驱动指令。 一个微调的DINOv3主干线和一个空间Tuning适配器产生多尺度的图像特性;一个粗细的到精细的解码器然后使用轨迹自注和相机投射的交叉透视来完善候选的路标. 其贡献是将自定的轨迹初始化与多尺度图像特征的迭代,几何制导采样相结合,而不是一个新的视觉主干线或注意力操作员. 在NAVSIM v1非反应评价上,之前报道的导航测试运行获得了88.03 PDMS. 由于该运行是使用导航性能选择的,因此这个数字是探索性的,不能解释为不带偏见的测试估计. 需要对未暴露数据进行验证选定的评价,重复运行,并进行计算测量,以确立通用化和效率。

articles.title: OREO: Fidelity Alignment in 3D Generation via On-the-fly Rendering-Editing Optimization
articles.content: Despite recent advancements in 3D generation, models often struggle to produce assets with high visual fidelity. To bridge this gap, we propose OREO, an alignment framework that enhances the realism of 3D generators by leveraging rich 2D diffusion priors. Instead of relying on static datasets, OREO establishes a dynamic optimization loop that produces on-the-fly edited renderings as 2D pseudo-targets. At its core, we introduce Reinforced Editing, which utilizes a 2D model to refine rendered views of the 3D output, enhancing their overall visual fidelity while preserving the underlying geometry, viewpoint, and content. These refined views serve as high-quality supervision targets, enabling the 3D generator to learn from its own generated samples and progressively improve its visual quality. Experiments demonstrate that OREO effectively improves upon pre-trained baselines, producing 3D assets with enhanced visual realism.

articles.title_zh: OREO: 三维生成时的 Fidelity 校对,通过飞上渲染-编辑优化
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在3D生成方面有所进步,但模型往往难以产生视觉高度忠诚的资产。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议OREO,一个通过利用丰富的2D扩散前身来增强3D生成器现实性的对齐框架. OREO不依靠静态数据集,而是建立动态优化循环,以2D伪目标生成在飞行中编辑的渲染. 作为核心,我们引入了强化编辑,它使用2D模型来改进对3D输出的渲染,增强它们的整体视觉忠诚度,同时保留基本的几何、观点和内容。 这些精细的观点成为高质量的监督目标,使3D生成器能够学习自己生成的样本,并逐步提高其视觉质量. 实验表明,OREO在经过预先训练的基线上得到了有效的改进,产生了具有增强视觉现实性的3D资产.

articles.title: Lightweight Vision Transformer-Based U-Net for Brain Tumor Segmentation from MRI
articles.content: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, and surgical guidance. Although Convolutional Neural Networks, particularly UNet, have achieved significant success in medical image segmentation, they often struggle to capture the long-range spatial dependencies required to model tumors with irregular shapes and complex boundaries. This paper proposes a lightweight Vision Transformer UNet that combines the hierarchical feature extraction capability of UNet with the global context modeling of Vision Transformers. The proposed architecture incorporates a compact ViT bottleneck within a U-Net encoder-decoder framework, enabling effective learning of both local and global features while maintaining computational efficiency with only 2.6 million trainable parameters. The model was evaluated on the TCGA LGG MRI Segmentation dataset, achieving a mean Intersection over Union of 0.8100 and a Dice score of 0.8446, outperforming the baseline UNet by 3.75% and 3.15%, respectively. Extensive quantitative and qualitative analyses, including confusion matrix evaluation, precision recall curves, per-image performance distribution, and tumor size dependency analysis, demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method for brain tumor segmentation.

articles.content_zh: 磁共振成像的准确脑瘤分化对于诊断、治疗规划和手术指导至关重要。 虽然革命神经网络,特别是UNet,在医学图像分割上取得了显著成功,但它们经常努力捕捉以不规则形状和复杂边界模拟肿瘤所需的远距离空间依赖性. 本文提出一个轻量级的Vision变形器UNet,将UNet的等级特征提取能力与全球的Vision变形器模型化结合起来. 拟议的架构将一个紧凑的ViT瓶颈纳入U-Net编码器-解码器框架内,从而能够有效学习当地和全球特点,同时保持计算效率,只有260万个可培训参数。 该模型在TCGA LGG核磁共振分解数据集上得到了评价,在联盟上空实现了0.8100的中间截面和0.8446的Dice分数,分别比基准UNet高3.75%和3.15%。 广泛的定量和定性分析,包括混淆矩阵评价,精准回溯曲线,每个图像的性能分布,以及肿瘤大小依赖性分析,都显示了拟议的脑瘤分化方法的有效性和稳健性.

articles.title: Mind the Gap: Mesh-Guided Repair of Broken Vessels
articles.content: Vessel segmentation is commonly optimized as voxel-wise classification, but small local errors can strongly disrupt vascular connectivity while having little effect on overlap scores. This is particularly problematic for downstream analyses that rely on centerlines, branches, connected components, or graph structure. We propose a mesh-guided post-processing framework for repairing broken vessel segmentations produced by nnU-Net. For each predicted binary mask, a deformable template mesh is fitted to the mask surface in physical space and used as a case-specific geometric scaffold. The fitted mesh is not voxelized as the final segmentation; instead, it guides conservative reconnection of disconnected components by proposing or validating thin bridge candidates under foreground-growth constraints. We evaluated this approach in three vascular anatomies using AortaSeg24 and SEGA for the aorta, TopCoW for the Circle of Willis, and PARSE for the pulmonary arteries. Performance is measured using Dice, connected-component Dice (ccDice), and the Betti-0 number. Across these datasets, repair substantially improved connectivity while preserving overlap: Dice remained nearly unchanged, whereas ccDice increased from 0.596 to 0.992 for aorta, from 0.722 to 0.835 for TopCoW, and from 0.028 to 0.862 for PARSE. The FOMAML meta-initialization further accelerated the fitting per-case, supporting practical mesh-based repair of the vascular topology. These results suggest that explicit mesh representations can provide a useful geometric prior for correcting topological failures in otherwise accurate voxel segmentations.

articles.title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
articles.content: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M, a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M.

articles.title_zh: C3M:长线跨会议多式联运记忆维护 任务
articles.content_zh: 长视距任务需要保存并随后在有界限的无线查询内存预算下收回跨会证. 现有的压缩可以丢弃细纹的视觉提示,或者拼接类似但互不兼容的观测. 我们介绍的是C3M,这是一个跨会场的多式联运记忆组织,它维持着相对于持久源文本图像证据的有界限的有效指数。 了解关系更新可加强安全冗余,同时保留互补和不兼容的记录。 在查询时间,编入预算的路由选择有用的索引页,并在固定的阅读器预算下扩展其相关的源证据. 这些机制共同建立了一个紧凑的、保留来源的多式联运记忆组织,用于跨会场长距离任务,保留时间区分和可靠下游推理所需的源链接。 代码见https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M.

articles.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Survival Prediction in Resected Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
articles.content:
Survival research in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is limited by the scarcity of datasets linking whole-slide histology with clinical, molecular, and long-term outcome data. We present a retrospective single-centre cohort of 302 patients who underwent PDAC resection at University Medical Center Gottingen. The dataset comprises 446 H&E whole-slide images, clinicopathological variables, targeted sequencing data for 154 patients, and overall-survival outcomes. During follow-up, 253 patients died, and the median follow-up was 76 months.
  To establish initial reference values, we evaluated fourteen survival-prediction configurations using identical five-repetition Monte Carlo cross-validation partitions. Ridge Cox regression using numeric clinicopathological variables achieved a mean concordance of $0.649 \pm 0.042$ and $0.652 \pm 0.046$ after adding KRAS and TP53 mutation status. The image-only attention model achieved $0.603 \pm 0.030$, while multimodal fusion achieved $0.619 \pm 0.025$, the highest concordance among the neural models. These results establish promising initial benchmarks for future research using this pancreas-specific multimodal dataset, paving the way for external validation.

articles.title_zh: 重新剖腹产的阿登诺卡西诺马存活预测的多式联运数据集
articles.content_zh:
胰腺沟渠性腺素瘤(PDAC)的存活研究因缺乏将整个滑坡组织学与临床,分子,长期结果数据联系起来的数据集而受到限制. 我们提出一个由302名病人组成的追溯性单中心组群,他们在哥廷根大学医疗中心接受过多功能调整。 该数据集包括446个H&E全滑图象、临床病理学变量、154个病人的定向测序数据以及总体存活结果。 在后续治疗期间,有253名患者死亡,中位跟踪时间为76个月.
为了确定初步参考值,我们评估了14个使用相同的5次重复蒙特卡洛交叉验证分区的存活预测配置。 山脊 使用数值临床病理学变量的考克斯回归在加入KRAS和TP53变异状态后,实现了平均对齐0.649\pm 0.042美元和0.652\pm 0.046美元. 仅图像关注模型实现0.603\pm 0.030美元,而多模式聚变实现0.619\pm 0.025美元,是神经模型中最高的和谐度. 这些结果为今后利用这种泛美特异性多式联运数据集进行研究确定了有希望的初步基准,为外部验证铺平了道路。

articles.title: SALI: Shot-Aware Late Interaction for Cross-Shot Relation Matching in Text-to-Video Retrieval using Film-Grammar Knowledge
articles.content: Text-to-video retrieval usually represents a video clip by a single embedding. This embedding often loses important relations between people. E.g., an interaction "Anna confronts Mark" is regularly filmed as alternating shot and reverse shot of both (Fig. 1a). No single shot or averaged embedding over clip shots captures this relation. Thus, we propose SALI (Shot-Aware Late Interaction). It extracts the subject and object from a single-sentence query, and matches the query, its subject and object text embeddings against each visual shot embedding of a video clip. The matching operator is greedy max or optimal transport. A film-grammar penalty in fine-tuning adds a small, consistent shift. Built on CLIP4Clip-meanP, SALI keeps overall recall on par on Condensed Movies and ActivityNet while raising R@1 on multi-shot relation queries by 3 and 12 points, the most among all compared methods, and improves such queries on MSR-VTT at a cost of 1.4 R@1 overall.

articles.title_zh: SALI: 使用 Film-Grammar 知识在文本到视频检索中进行跨光线匹配的Shot-Aware晚间交互
articles.content_zh: 文本到视频检索通常通过单嵌入表示视频剪辑. 这种嵌入往往会失去人与人之间的重要关系. 例如,一个互动"Anna faces Mark"经常被拍摄为两者交替拍摄和反拍(图1a). 任何单一镜头或平均嵌入在剪辑镜头上都无法捕捉到这种关联. 因此,我们提议使用SALI(Shot-Award Late Interactive)。 它从一个单一的判罚查询中提取主题和对象,并与查询,其主题和对象文本的嵌入相对应每个视频片段嵌入的视觉镜头. 匹配的运算符是贪婪的最大或最佳运输. 微调中的电影语法处罚增加了一个小的,一贯的转变. SALI基于CLIP4Clip-meanP,保持了对Condensed Movies and ActionNet上平面的整体召回,同时将多镜头关系查询的R@1提升到3和12点,是所有比较方法中最优的,并改进了MSR-VTT上的此类查询,总成本为1.4R@1.

articles.title: AgriCountDINO: Parameter-Efficient Exemplar-Guided Counting and Localization in Agriculture
articles.content: Accurate counting and localization of plants and their organs support phenotyping and yield estimation, yet target appearance, scale, and density vary widely across species and imaging conditions. Exemplar boxes specify the target without category-specific retraining, and point predictions identify the individual instances contributing to the count. We introduce AgriCountDINO, a parameter-efficient exemplar-guided framework for joint counting and localization. It conditions frozen multiscale DINOv3 features on exemplar appearance and size, then progressively decodes them into target points. Missed-object recovery extends supervision to targets overlooked by initial matching, and exemplar-adaptive point NMS filters duplicate predictions according to exemplar scale. With 8.4M trainable parameters, approximately one-tenth of TasselNetV4's, AgriCountDINO achieves a three-shot MAE of 11.92 on the TPC-268 benchmark, reducing counting error by 9.7\% while providing individual target locations. Trained only on TPC-268, it achieves a zero-shot MAE of 14.25 on unseen generic object categories in FSC-147, improving upon the best compared zero-shot method by 6.0\% without target-domain training or fine-tuning.

articles.title_zh: AgriCountDINO:农业统计和地方化参数
articles.content_zh: 对植物及其器官进行精确的计数和本地化,有助于对树皮和产量进行估计,但目标外观、规模和密度因物种和成像条件而大不相同。 实例框指定目标,而不进行特定类别的再培训,点预测则识别有助于计数的单个实例. 我们引入了AgriContDINO,这是一个具有参数效率的用于联合计算和本地化的示范指导框架。 它在实例外观和尺寸上将多尺度的DINov3特性设为冻结条件,然后逐渐将其解码为目标点. 误差对象恢复将监管延伸到初始匹配忽略的目标,实例适应点NMS过滤器按照实例尺度重复预测. 使用8.4M可训练参数,约十分之一的塔塞尔NetV4's,AgriCountDINO在TPC-268基准上实现了11.92的三发MAE,在提供单个目标位置的同时将计数错误减少9.7\%. 它只在TPC-268上接受过训练,在FSC-147的未见通用物体类别上实现了14.25的零射MAE,在没有目标域训练或微调的情况下,在最佳的比零射法上改进了6.0\%.

articles.title: Industrial Anomaly Detection via Defect-Grounded Reasoning in Visual Latent Space
articles.content: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) is evolving beyond conventional detection and localization toward multimodal inspection systems that can describe, explain, and reason about fine-grained defects. Although recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based methods improve anomaly understanding through textual reasoning and visual guidance, they face two limitations in fine-grained inspection. First, their visual refinement often requires iteratively revisiting local image regions or augmenting with additional tools. Second, the resulting local defect evidence may not be reliably preserved throughout subsequent reasoning. To address these, we propose Anomaly-LR, a defect-grounded latent reasoning framework that first forms a global understanding of the input and then progressively refines anomaly-relevant representations directly in the visual latent space. We further construct IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD instruction dataset designed for latent reasoning, containing 22,228 image-question instances from 4,523 industrial images, with global textual reasoning traces and region-level visual annotations. Extensive experiments show that Anomaly-LR achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable-scale methods across multiple IAD benchmarks, without requiring external references or tools. The code and data will be released at https://github.com/Yen666/Anomaly-LR.

articles.title_zh: 在视觉后期空间通过缺陷-环绕理性进行工业异常检测
articles.content_zh: 工业异常检测正在超越常规检测和本地化,转向能够描述、解释和说明精细缺陷的多式联运检查系统。 虽然最近的基于多模式的大型语言模型(MLLM)方法通过文字推理和视觉指导提高了反常理解,但它们在精细的检查中面临两个限制. 首先,它们的视觉改进往往需要反复地重新审视当地图像区域或增加其他工具。 其次,由此产生的当地缺陷证据可能无法在其后的整个推理过程中得到可靠保存。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立异常-LR这一基于缺陷的潜在推理框架,首先对投入形成全球理解,然后逐步完善视觉潜在空间中与异常有关的表述。 我们进一步构建了IAD-LR-22K,这是第一个为潜伏推理设计的IAD指令数据集,包含来自4,523个工业图像的22,228个图像问题实例,并带有全球文字推理痕迹和区域一级的视觉说明. 广泛的实验表明,Anomaly-LR在跨多个内审司基准的可比尺度方法中实现最新性能,而不需要外部参考或工具。 该代码和数据将在https://github.com/Yen666/Anomaly-LR上发布。

articles.title: Dense Coverage, Sparse Refinement: Byte-Constrained Cooperative Perception
articles.content: Collaborative perception improves autonomous perception by sharing intermediate Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features across connected agents, but dense feature exchange is difficult to deploy under strict Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) bandwidth limits. Existing efficient methods typically either compress the full feature map uniformly, spending bits on low-value background, or sparsify communication, risking the loss of useful context. We propose a coverage-refinement design for byte-constrained cooperative perception: each agent transmits a highly compressed coarse layer over the full BEV map and allocates the remaining budget to selected high-resolution patches. A Task-Aware Benefit Selector ranks cells by estimated downstream utility, enabling deterministic budgeted refinement and zero-retraining adaptation to changing bandwidth. The receiver reconstructs a dense BEV tensor compatible with standard fusion modules. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and OPV2V show strong accuracy-payload trade-offs at kilobyte-scale budgets. On DAIR-V2X, our method reaches 0.60 AP@0.7 at only 1.87 KB per non-ego agent, compared with 0.52 at 4.61 KB for uniform SimVQ compression. Controlled diagnostics further show that the gain arises from coverage-refinement allocation rather than quantization alone. Code will be published.

articles.title_zh: 深度覆盖, Sparse 改进:字节约束 合作观念
articles.content_zh: 协作感知通过共享中间鸟-眼-视(BEV)在互联物剂上的特性来提升自主感知,但密集的特性交换在严格的车辆对一切(V2X)带宽限制下难以部署. 现有的高效方法通常要么统一压缩完整的特征映射,在低值背景上花费比特,要么将通信螺旋化,冒失去有用上下文的风险. 我们为字节约束的合作感知提出覆盖-精炼设计:每个剂在BEV全图上传输一个高度压缩的粗层,并将剩余预算分配给选定的高分辨率补丁. 一个任务-预知利益选择器按估计下游用途排列单元格,从而能够确定预算的改进和零再训练以适应不断变化的带宽。 接收器重建一个与标准聚变模块兼容的密集BEV拉伸器. 对DAIR-V2X和OPV2V的实验显示,在千字节规模预算中,精确率与负载的权衡十分有力。 在DAIR-V2X上,我们的方法达到0.60 AP@0.7,每非ego剂只有1.87 KB,而4.61 KB为统一SimVQ压缩0.52. 受控制的诊断进一步表明,收益来自扩大范围的分配,而不是仅仅量化。 守则将公布。

articles.title: Frame-to-Panorama Localization and Context-Aware Sampling for Scene-Specific Ship Detection in a Smart Marina Testbed
articles.content: Smart maritime infrastructures provide continuous access to heterogeneous sensing streams, enabling repeated experimentation, digital-twin development, and AI-based maritime services. However, sensing hardware alone is not sufficient for scene-specific model development: historical video streams must also be spatially indexed, contextualized, and reduced to informative subsets for annotation. This paper presents a frame-to-panorama localization and context-aware sampling pipeline for ship detection in historical PTZ maritime video lacking reliable pan, tilt, and zoom metadata. The main contribution is an end-to-end data-curation approach that recovers camera-view information from historical PTZ video and combines it with environmental context and visual diversity to construct compact, scene-specific training sets. Specifically, frames are localized on a reference panorama using SuperPoint and LightGlue, enriched with weather and solar-state metadata, and selected through diversity sampling to preserve variation across camera view and environmental conditions. A second context-aware stage targets under-represented distant-vessel cases near the horizon using tile-level visual embeddings and Gaussian Mixture Model clustering. Applied within the CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina testbed, the proposed pipeline reduces 40,718 candidate frames to 220 images for annotation, corresponding to a 99.5% reduction. A YOLO26-m detector fine-tuned on this subset achieves a mean AP50 of 94.78% $\pm$ 0.51% and a mean AP50-95 of 75.10% $\pm$ 1.73% under sequence-grouped five-fold cross-validation. These results demonstrate that highly redundant infrastructure video streams can be transformed into compact, spatially and contextually diverse training sets for scene-specific detector adaptation while substantially reducing annotation effort.

articles.title_zh: 在智能玛丽娜测试床内进行场景-特定船舶检测的框架-至太平洋定位和背景-了解取样
articles.content_zh: 智能的海洋基础设施提供不断获得不同传感器流的机会,从而能够重复试验、数字双向发展和基于人工智能的海事服务。 然而,仅靠感知硬件不足以进行场景特异性模型开发:历史视频流也必须在空间上进行索引,上下文化,并缩小为信息化子集进行注释. 本文在缺乏可靠锅、倾斜和缩放元数据的历史PTZ海洋视频中,介绍了船体探测的帧到剖面本地化和上下文感取样管道。 主要贡献是采用端到端的数据校准方法,从历史PTZ视频中回收相机视图信息,并将其与环境背景和视觉多样性相结合,构建紧凑,场景特异的培训集. 具体地说,框架是用SuperPoint和LightGlue的参考全景进行本地化的,并用天气和太阳状态元数据加以丰富,通过多样性取样加以选择,以保持摄像头和环境条件的变异。 第二上下文感知阶段利用砖瓦级视觉嵌入和高斯混音模型集群,瞄准地平线附近代表性不足的远射器病例. 在CMMI Mdigi-I Smart Marina试验床内应用,拟议的管道将40 718个备选框架减少到220个图像,用于注释,相当于减少99.5%。 该子集上的YOLO26m探测器微调后,在序列组合的五倍交叉验证下,平均AP50达到94.78%\pm$0.51%,平均AP50-95达到75.10%\pm$1.73%. 这些结果表明,高度冗余的基础设施视频流可以转变为紧凑、空间和背景多样的成套培训,用于针对具体场景的探测器改造,同时大幅减少注释工作。

articles.title: Pose Adaptive Dynamic FiLM Modulation for Visual Speech Recognition
articles.content: Head-pose variation introduces substantial appearance transformations in visual speech recognition (VSR), making pose-aware feature modulation desirable. However, performance degradation and unwanted feature interactions may result from using numerous Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) circuits with fixed modulation intensity. We propose a Pose Adaptive Dynamic FiLM framework with a Dynamic Residual FiLM (DR-FiLM) modulator that predicts input-dependent weights to adaptively control the strength of pose-conditioned modulation. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 demonstrate that unweighted multi-pathway modulation substantially degrades phoneme recognition, increasing PER to 20.33% and 29.42%, respectively, compared with 16.20% and 20.96% for the single ResFiLM configuration. In contrast, the proposed DR-FiLM with dynamic Deep-Res weighting reduces PER to 15.74% on LRS2 and 23.91% on LRS3, substantially mitigating the adverse effects of unweighted modulation. The analysis of the learned weights further reveals a consistent tendency to assign greater weight to the deeper FiLM pathway as head-pose variation increases. These results show that merging pose-conditioned FiLM circuits is more efficient when the modulation strength is dynamically controlled.

articles.title_zh: Pose 适应性动态 FiLM 视觉语音识别模块
articles.content_zh: 头-头变异在视觉语音识别(VSR)中引入了实质性的外观转变,使得姿势感知特征的调制是可取的. 然而,性能退化和不想要的特性相互作用可能是由于使用许多具有固定调制强度的地貌-智能线性调制(FiLM)电路。 我们提出一个Pose适应性动态FiLM框架,配有动态残留FiLM(DR-FiLM)调制器,预测依赖输入的权重,以适应性地控制姿势条件调制的强度. LRS2和LRS3的实验表明,未加权的多路径调制会大幅降低电话识别,PER分别提高到20.33%和29.42%,而单张ResFiLM配置的PER则分别上升到16.20%和20.96%. 与此相对照,拟议的具有动态深应权重的DR-FiLM将PER在LRS2上降低到15.74%,在LRS3上降低到23.91%,大大减轻了未加权调制的不利影响. 对所学到的权重的分析进一步揭示出一种一贯的趋势,即随着头-头差异的增加,对更深的FiLM路径给予更大的权重。 这些结果表明,当调制强度被动态控制时,合并装配条件的FiLM电路的效率更高.

articles.title: Detecting Glaucoma Across Multi-ethnic Myopic and Non-Myopic Populations Using an Uncertainty-Aware Vision Transformer: A Multicentre Model Development and Validation Study
articles.content: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based glaucoma detection from colour fundus photographs (CFP) offers scalable screening, but performance may decline on external datasets because of differences in ground-truth definitions, populations, and coexisting conditions such as high myopia (HM). We developed and validated a Vision Transformer-based deep learning (DL) model for glaucoma detection across multi-ethnic cohorts with and without HM. Methods: A ViT-B/16 model with predictive uncertainty estimation was developed using 56,483 CFPs (57.1% with myopia; 14.4% with HM). Glaucoma labels were standardised using clinical, imaging, and perimetry data. The model was validated on 16 independent datasets across three continents, including four datasets with explicit HM labels. Findings: Internal AUROC was 98.7% (95% CI 98.2-99.1%), with sensitivity 94.5% and specificity 97.3%. Across 16 external datasets from eight countries, AUROCs ranged from 86.4% to 99.6%. In HM eyes, internal AUROC was 97.8% (95% CI 96.1-99.2%), with sensitivity 94.8% and specificity 93.7%. External HM AUROCs were 86.5% in the Beijing Eye Study and 93.3%, 91.8%, and 85.5% in hospital-based datasets from Taiwan, Thailand, and South Korea. In an exploratory HM clinical evaluation, the model had higher CFP-only diagnostic accuracy than ophthalmologists and trained graders (92.0% vs 70.0%; p=0.008) and performed comparably to glaucoma specialists using full clinical information. Interpretation: The model showed robust glaucoma detection across myopic and non-myopic multi-ethnic populations and may support AI-assisted screening in settings with high HM prevalence.

articles.title_zh: 利用不确定的、敏锐的视野变换器探测跨多族裔的闪光眼和非闪光眼人群:多中心模型开发和验证研究
articles.content_zh: 背景:人工智能(AI)基于彩色Fundus照片(CFP)的青光眼检测提供可伸缩的筛选,但由于地面真实定义,人群,高视线(HM)等共存条件的差异,外部数据集的性能可能会下降. 我们开发并验证了基于Vision Transformer(DL)的深层学习模型,用于在有和无HM的多种族群体中检测青光眼。 方法:利用56,483个CFPs(57.1%为眼球;14.4%为HM)开发了带有预测性不确定性估计的Vit-B/16模型。 青光眼标签通过临床、成像和近距离测量数据标准化。 该模型在三大洲的16个独立数据集上进行了验证,其中包括4个带有明确HM标签的数据集. 调查结果:AUROC内部为98.7%(95% CI 98.2-99.1%),敏感度为94.5%,特异性为97.3%。 在来自8个国家的16个外部数据集中,AUROC从86.4%到99.6%不等。 在HM眼中,AUROC内部为97.8%(95% CI 96.1-99.2%),敏感度为94.8%,特异性为93.7%。 来自台湾、泰国和韩国的外部HM AUROC为86.5%,93.3%、91.8%和85.5%。 在一项探索性HM临床评估中,该模型的CFP-唯一诊断精度高于眼科医生和经过培训的分级员(92.0%对70.0%;p=0.008),并使用完整的临床信息与青光眼专家进行对比。 解释:该模型显示在全视和非视多族裔人群中进行了强力青光眼检测,并可能支持在HM流行率高的环境中进行人工智能辅助筛查。

articles.title: When Misalignment Becomes Supervision: Structured Label Noise in Supervised Synthetic CT Generation
articles.content: Supervised synthetic CT (sCT) generation is commonly trained and evaluated as voxel-wise regression against registered reference CT images. In practice, MRI-CT and CBCT-CT pairs are aligned through registration procedures that leave residual misalignments. These residuals are not independent intensity noise but spatially coherent geometric discrepancies that act as structured label noise. We investigate how this registration-induced bias affects supervised MRI-to-CT and CBCT-to-CT synthesis on 1,784 paired patients covering five anatomical regions. Voxel-wise scores strongly depend on the consistency between the registration used to build the training targets and the one used for evaluation: models score best when both conventions match, showing that networks partly learn the geometric convention of the registration pipeline and that standard metrics reward it. Training on more anatomically consistent registrations reduces prediction variability and improves out-of-distribution robustness, and CT-only controls show that registration alone produces metric errors in the range of top challenge submissions. To mitigate the limits of voxel-wise supervision, we introduce a perceptual loss computed in the feature space of a pretrained Segment Anything encoder. Compared with MAE-only and VGG-based objectives, it improves downstream segmentation and yields sharper, more structurally coherent sCT. Perceptual and voxel-wise metrics disagree under imperfect alignment and agree when the evaluation geometry is reliable. These results identify registration-induced bias as a central confounder in supervised sCT generation and argue for complementing voxel-wise agreement with anatomy-oriented evaluation criteria.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当错配成为监督时:在监督合成CT生成中结构化标签噪声
articles.content_zh: 受监督的合成CT(SCT)生成通常经过培训和评价,按照已登记的参考CT图像,按阴道回归法进行。 在实践中,核磁共振-CT和核磁共振-CT-CT对通过登记程序进行对齐,从而造成残留的错配。 这些残留物不是独立的强度噪声,而是空间连贯的几何差异,起到结构化标签噪声的作用. 我们调查这种登记引起的偏差如何影响覆盖5个解剖区的1,784名配对病人的受监督的核磁共振对-CT和CBCT对-CT合成。 Voxel-wise的分数在很大程度上取决于用于建立培训目标的登记与用于评价的分数之间的一致性:模型在两种公约相匹配时得分最好,表明网络部分地学习了登记管道的几何常规,标准衡量尺度奖励它。 关于更具解剖一致性的登记的培训可减少预测的可变性,提高分配外的稳健性,而仅通过CT控制即可发现,仅登记就会产生最高质疑提交书范围的衡量错误。 为了减轻阴道监督的限度,我们引入了在预加固的区段任何编码器的特性空间中计算出的感知损失。 与基于MAE的和基于VGG的目标相比,它改善了下游的分化,并产生更尖锐,结构上更连贯的SCT. 在不完美的对齐下,概念和阴道的衡量标准存在分歧,并同意何时评价几何是可靠的。 这些结果将登记引起的偏见确定为受监督的SCT生成中的核心混淆者,并主张用以解剖学为导向的评价标准来补充阴道协议。

articles.title: Segment-Level Risk Discovery in Online Handwriting for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
articles.content: Online handwriting provides a non-invasive and low-cost behavioral biomarker for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection, as it reflects both cognitive planning and fine motor control. Existing handwriting-based AD detection methods usually rely on global trajectory features or whole-sample representations, which can be strongly affected by individual writing style, task-specific variation, and acquisition noise. In this paper, we propose NormPaST-Risk, a healthy-normative Paper-Air selective trajectory state-space risk network for interpretable AD detection from online handwriting. Instead of treating the entire trajectory as a single holistic representation, our method reformulates AD handwriting detection as local disease-relevant segment discovery. Specifically, a multi-scale temporal encoder captures stroke dynamics at different temporal resolutions, while a selective Paper-Air state-space encoder models long-range handwriting progression and distinguishes on-paper motor execution from in-air planning and transition behaviors. To explicitly characterize abnormal deviations, a healthy normative branch learns normal handwriting dynamics from healthy controls, and a task-aware multi-expert segment-risk module estimates segment-level AD risk calibrated by hidden-state changes and normative deviations. A weakly supervised segment-level objective further enables high-risk segment discovery without manual segment annotations. Experiments on the DARWIN benchmark demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior AD/HC classification performance compared with existing methods. Moreover, the discovered high-risk segments can be projected back to the original handwriting trajectory, providing interpretable evidence associated with AD-related handwriting variations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默氏病检测在线手册中的分级风险发现
articles.content_zh: 在线笔迹为阿尔茨海默氏病(AD)的检测提供了非侵入性和低成本的行为生物学标志,因为它既反映了认知规划和精细的运动控制. 现有的基于笔迹的AD检测方法通常依赖于全局轨迹特征或全镜化的表示,这可能会受到个人写作风格,任务特异性,以及获取噪音的强烈影响. 在本文中,我们提出NormPaST-Risk,一个健康规范的纸张-航空选择性轨迹状态-空间风险网络,用于在线笔迹的可解释的AD检测. 我们的方法不是将整个轨迹作为单一的整体表述,而是将AD笔迹检测重新编订为局部与疾病相关的部分发现. 具体来说,一个多尺度的时间编码器在不同的时间分辨率上捕捉中风动力学,而选择性的Paper-Air state-space编码器模型长程笔迹进化,并区分纸上运动执行与空中规划和过渡行为. 要明确特征异常偏差,健康规范分支要从健康控制中学习正常笔迹动态,任务感知多专家分层风险模块估算分层AD风险,通过隐藏状态变化和规范偏差进行校准. 监督不力的分部一级目标进一步使高风险分部的发现得以进行,而无需人工分部说明。 对DARWIN基准的实验表明,与现有方法相比,拟议框架取得了更好的反倾销/人道主义协调员分类绩效。 此外,发现的高风险区段可追溯到原始的笔迹轨迹,提供与反倾销有关的笔迹变化有关的可解释的证据。

articles.title: On the second-order optimization for spiking neural networks
articles.content: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient alternative to conventional neural networks by exploiting sparse, binary spikes, and event-driven computation. However, the training of SNNs remains challenging, as spiking activations create a sharp loss landscape that hinders training, and diagonal-curvature optimizers such as the Adam family may fail to capture this geometry. The extension of curvature-based optimization methods to SNNs is further complicated by the sparse, discrete, and temporally recurrent nature of their underlying dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose SpiKFAX, a second-order optimization method that formulates a computationally tractable, Kronecker-factored approximation of the Fisher information matrix specifically adapted to the structure of SNNs. Empirical evaluation across five architectures and seven datasets demonstrates that SpiKFAX consistently yields improvements in test accuracy and training stability relative to other popular optimizers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在第二顺序优化 溢出神经网络
articles.content_zh: Spiking神经网络(SNNs)通过利用稀疏的二元突起和事件驱动的计算,为常规神经网络提供了节能替代方案. 然而,对SNNs的训练仍然具有挑战性,因为尖锐的激活会形成一个尖锐的失落景观,阻碍训练,亚当家族等对角曲线优化器可能无法捕捉到这种几何特征. 以曲率为基础的优化方法推广到SNN更加复杂,因为其基础动态的零散、分散和时间上的重复性质。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用SpiKFAX这一二阶优化方法,该方法将专门适应SNN结构的Fisher信息矩阵形成一个可计算可牵引的、由Kronecker制造的近似值。 对5个架构和7个数据集的实证评价表明,相对于其他流行的优化者而言,SpiKFAX在测试精度和培训稳定性方面始终得到提高。

articles.title: A Hybrid CNN--State-Space--Attention Backbone with Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining for 12-Lead ECG Classification
articles.content: Automatic 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) classification requires representations that jointly capture local waveform morphology, long-range temporal dynamics, and cross-lead dependencies, yet integrating these properties within a single efficient architecture remains challenging. This paper introduces a hybrid CNN-SSM-Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification. A convolutional stem performs early waveform tokenization and temporal reduction, mixed state-space and depthwise-convolutional blocks model temporal dynamics and local morphology, and a late self-attention stage enables global token interaction at reduced resolution. To improve transfer from unlabeled data, we further develop an ECG-oriented Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining (JEPA) framework. Unlike ViT-based JEPA methods that mask patch tokens before the encoder, the proposed method samples span masks at the latent temporal resolution and projects them back to the waveform domain, then predicts clean latent targets from a momentum encoder without waveform reconstruction. Experiments on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL, with pretraining on approximately 350K unlabeled CODE-15 recordings, show that the proposed backbone provides strong supervised baselines under a compact parameter budget. JEPA pretraining further improves transfer, particularly in reduced-label settings and under both full fine-tuning and LoRA-based adaptation. Code: https://github.com/yakoubbazi/Hybrid_ECG_Jepa
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CNN-State-Space-Attention Backbone和12号主电联预预训 分类
articles.content_zh: 自动十二铅心电图(ECG)分类需要能联合捕捉局部波形形态,长程时间动态,以及跨铅依赖的表示,然而将这些特性整合在一个单一高效的架构中仍然具有挑战性. 本文引入了用于12头ECG分类的CNN-SSM-Attention混合主干线. 演化干能进行早期的波形示意和时间缩短,混合的状态空间和深智演化区块模拟时间动力学和局部形态学,而后期的自觉阶段则能使全球在降低分辨率时进行信号交互. 为了改进无标签数据的传输,我们进一步发展了面向ECG的联合预测培训框架。 与基于ViT的JEPA方法在编码器前遮盖补丁符号不同,拟议方法样本在潜在时间分辨率上遮盖并投射回波形域,然后从动力编码器中预测干净的潜伏目标而不进行波形重建. 关于CPSC2018、Chapman-Shaoxing和PTB-XL的实验,对大约350K无标签的CODE-15录音进行预先培训,显示拟议的主干线在紧凑的参数预算下提供了强有力的监督基线。 联合环保局的预训进一步改善了转让,特别是在减标签环境下以及在全面调整和基于LORA的适应下。 代码:https://github.com/yakoubbazi/Hybrid_ECG_Jepa 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-03-02.

articles.title: Free-Init: Scan-Free, Motion-Free, and Correspondence-Free Initialization for Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Systems
articles.content: Robust initialization is crucial for online systems. In the letter, a high-frequency and resilient initialization framework is designed for LiDAR-inertial systems, leveraging both inertial sensors and Doppler LiDAR. The innovative FMCW Doppler LiDAR opens up a novel avenue for robotic sensing by capturing not only point range but also Doppler velocity via the intrinsic Doppler effect. By fusing point-wise Doppler velocity with inertial measurements under non-inertial kinematics, the proposed framework, Free-Init, eliminates reliance on motion undistortion of LiDAR scans, excitation motions, and map correspondences during the initialization phase. Free-Init is also plug-and-play compatible with typical LiDAR-inertial systems and is versatile to handle a wide range of initial motions when the system starts, including stationary, dynamic, and even violent motions. The embedded Doppler-inertial velocimeter ensures fast convergence and high-frequency performance, delivering outputs exceeding 10 kHz. Comprehensive experiments on diverse platforms and across myriad motion scenes validate the framework's effectiveness. The results demonstrate the superior performance of Free-Init, highlighting the necessity of fast, resilient, and dynamic initialization for online systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Free-Init:用于多普勒LiDAR-Inertial系统的扫描-Free,Motion-Free,以及通信-Free初始化
articles.content_zh: 强有力的初始化对于在线系统至关重要。 在字母中,为LiDAR-惰性系统设计了一个高频和弹性初始化框架,同时利用惯性传感器和Doppler LiDAR. 创新的FMCW 多普勒LiDAR通过内在的多普勒效应不仅捕捉到点范围,还捕捉到多普勒速度,开启了机器人感知的新途径. 通过在非惯性动能下将点向的多普勒速度与惯性度测量相融合,拟议的框架Free-Init消除了在初始化阶段对LiDAR扫描的运动分解,激发运动,以及映射对应的依赖. Free-Init也是和典型的LiDAR-inertial系统兼容的插座和游戏,在系统启动时具有多种能力处理广泛的初始动作,包括静止,动态,甚至暴力动作. 嵌入式Doppler-enertial velocimeter可确保快速趋同和高频性能,输出量超过10kHz. 在各种平台和各种运动场景的全面实验验证了框架的有效性. 结果显示Free-Init的优异性能,突出了快速,弹性,动态初始化对在线系统的必要性.

articles.title: FMCW-LIO: A Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
articles.content: Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) or simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods heavily rely on geometric features of environments, as LiDARs primarily provide range measurements instead of motion measurements. From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs. FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter, we propose FMCW-LIO, a novel and robust LIO, leveraging intrinsic Doppler measurements from FMCW Doppler LiDARs. To correctly exploit Doppler velocities, a motion compensation method is designed, and a Doppler-aided observation model is applied for on-manifold state estimation. Then, dynamic points can be effectively removed by the Doppler criteria, deriving more consistent geometric observations. FMCW-LIO eventually achieves accurate state estimation and static mapping, even in structure-degenerated environments. Extensive experiments in diverse scenes are performed and FMCW-LIO outperforms other algorithms on both accuracy and robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FMCW-LIO:多普勒LiDAR惯性测量
articles.content_zh: 常规的LiDAR-惰性偏振仪(LIO)或同地定位和绘图(SLAM)方法严重依赖环境的几何特征,因为LiDARs主要提供测距而不是运动测量. 然而从今以后,由于小说"频率调制连续波"(FMCW)多普勒LiDARs,情况发生了变化. FMCW多普勒LiDARs不仅以高分辨率提供点范围,还通过多普勒效应来捕捉即时点多普勒速度. 在这封信中,我们提议FMCW-LIO,这是一种新颖而强健的LIO,利用FMCW的内在多普勒测量法. Doppler LiDARs. 为了正确利用多普勒速度,设计出一种运动补偿方法,并应用多普勒辅助的观察模型进行狂想状态估计. 然后,动态点可以通过多普勒标准有效去除,得出更一致的几何观测. FMCW-LIO最终实现准确的状态估计和静态映射,甚至在结构分解环境中也是如此. 在各种场景中进行了广泛的实验,FMCW-LIO在准确性和稳健性上都超越了其他算法.

articles.title: Shadow Reduction in Ultrasound Imaging Using Differentiable Simulation and Radiance Field Decomposition
articles.content: Acoustic shadows from bone and other highly attenuating tissues obscure clinically important structures in ultrasound. In fetal brain imaging, skull-induced artefacts disproportionately degrade the hemisphere closer to the transducer (proximal), limiting symmetric assessment of the two hemispheres. Existing correction methods require raw scanner data, impose restrictive assumptions on tissue properties, or rely on generative models that may hallucinate anatomy. We present RFlash, a physics-informed post-processing method that decomposes beamformed ultrasound images into explicit attenuation and scatter-intensity maps using a differentiable radiance-field formulation of image formation. Attenuation-adaptive re-rendering then removes the dependence of the signal at each depth on the intervening tissue, equivalent to virtually advancing the transducer into the tissue. Across 1,261 3D fetal brain volumes, 143 real 2D curvilinear abdominal scans, and 1,200 simulated 2D linear-probe liver scans, RFlash reduces shadow-related intensity differences more effectively than classical Hughes-Duck attenuation correction. For a gestational-age model trained on the distal hemisphere (further from the transducer) and applied to the proximal hemisphere, prediction error decreases by 5.1 days (40%) relative to the original images. The estimated attenuation maps also yield shadow-confidence maps that improve random-forest bone-shadow segmentation over the image alone and receive greater SHAP importance than an existing neural confidence-map baseline, suggesting greater physical consistency. RFlash requires neither hardware modification nor access to raw scanner data and supports 2D and 3D acquisitions with linear and curvilinear probes, making it widely applicable allowing clinicians to use our method on their already acquired scanners and images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在超声道成像中采用可分化模拟和辐射场分解的阴影还原
articles.content_zh: 在超声波中,从骨骼和其他高度衰减的组织产生的声影模糊了临床上重要的结构. 在胎儿脑成像中,由头骨引起的人工制品使半球更接近转录器(近相),从而限制了对两个半球的对称性评估。 现有的校正方法需要原始的扫描仪数据,对组织属性施加限制性的假设,或者依赖可能产生解剖幻觉的基因模型. 我们提出了RFlash,一种物理上知情的后处理方法,它利用图像形成的可分辨的光场配方,将束状超声波图像分解为明显的减弱和散射强度图. 加速-适应再还原,然后去除每个深度信号对介入组织所依赖性,相当于几乎将转录器推进到组织. 纵观1,261个3D胎儿脑体积,143个真2D卷曲腹部扫描,以及1,200个模拟2D线性预测肝脏扫描,RFlash比古典Hughes-Duck衰减校正更有效地减少与影子相关的强度差异. 对于一个在分层半球(从转录器取出)接受训练并应用于相近半球的孕期模型,预测误差比原始图像减少5.1天(40%). 估计的衰减图还生成了影子自信图,这些地图仅能改善图像上的随机林地骨影分化,比现有的神经自信图基线更具有SHAP的重要性,表明物理上的一致性更大. RFlash既不要求硬件修改,也不要求获取原始扫描仪数据,并且支持2D和3D的购置,配有线性探测器和曲面探测器,使其广泛适用,允许临床医生在其已经获得的扫描仪和图像中使用我们的方法。

articles.title: Domain Recentering and Confidence-Weighted Prior Calibration for Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong zero-shot classification, yet under distribution shift, visual embeddings drift from fixed text embeddings. Training-free calibration avoids the per-sample optimization of prompt learning, but prior feature calibration gives each image the full bias of one hard cluster. We propose Domain Recentering with Confidence Calibration (DRC), a training-free method adapting CLIP from a set of unlabeled target images. DRC fits a Gaussian mixture once and subtracts from each embedding a posterior-weighted average of component means. It then removes residual class preference with a log-prior correction, estimating the prior from confidence-weighted predictions. Among compared methods, DRC achieves the highest average accuracy on cross-domain datasets, exceeding zero-shot CLIP by 4.13 and 5.07 points with ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50, with gains over CLIP also holding under ImageNet distribution shifts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视野-语言模型的域名更新和信心加权前校准
articles.content_zh: CLIP等Visual-language-language models实现强烈的"零发"分类,然而在发行转移中,视觉嵌入从固定文本嵌入中漂移. 无训练校正能避免了即时学习的每个样本优化,但前作的特征校正能使每个图像完全偏向一个硬集群. 我们提议用信心校正(DRC)进行域名更新(Domain Creastering with Confessibilation Calculation),这是一种从一组无标签的目标图像中修改CLIP的无训练方法. DRC 符合高斯混合物一次,从每个嵌入的后加权平均值中减去组件平均值。 然后通过对数前修正来去除剩余类偏好,从置信加权预测中估算出前作. 在比较方法中,刚果民主共和国的跨域数据集平均精度最高,与Vit-B/16和ResNet-50相比,CLIP的零射入点比CLIP多出4.13和5.07分,与CLIP相比的收益也保持在ImageNet分布转移下。

articles.title: Learning a Flow to Self-Supervised Representations
articles.content: Explicit geometric references offer a direct way to structure self-supervised representations. Existing adversarial distribution-matching formulations, however, require costly encoder-critic optimization. We introduce Flow-Based Distribution Matching (FBDM), a non-adversarial framework that learns this reference-directed geometry through spherical conditional velocity regression. An ETF-inspired reference allows its number of components K' to exceed the auxiliary flow dimension d* while retaining structured geometric separation. We assign both augmented views of each image to the same target, while limiting how many images each reference center can receive. An explicit alignment loss further pulls the two views' representations closer together. Experiments across benchmarks ranging from CIFAR to ImageNet show that FBDM achieves performance nearly on par with DM and remains competitive with existing SSL methods. Matched training-cost comparisons show a 1.48- to 1.83-fold speedup over DM with a negligible increase in GPU memory usage. We also provide a theoretical explanation for the usefulness of the learned representations: under stated conditions, we bound the downstream misclassification rate in terms of the FBDM pretraining loss.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习自我监督的代表
articles.content_zh: 明确的几何参考文献提供了一种直接的方法来构建自我监督的表述. 然而,现有的对抗式配给配方需要成本高昂的编码器-批评器优化。 我们引入了以流为主的分布匹配(FBDM),这是一种非对抗性的框架,通过球形有条件的速度回归来学习这种参照方向的几何. ETF所启发的参考允许其组件K'的数量超过辅助流维d*,同时保留结构几何分离. 我们把每个图像的扩展视图分配给同一个目标,同时限制每个参考中心可以接收多少图像。 明确的调整损失进一步使两种观点的表述更加接近。 从CIFAR到ImageNet的各种基准的实验表明,FBDM的性能几乎与DM相同,并且仍然与现有的SSL方法具有竞争力. 匹配的训练成本比较显示,比DM快1.48至1.83倍,GPU内存使用量可忽略不计地增加. 我们还从理论上解释了学到的陈述的用处:在所述条件下,我们将下游错误分类率与FBDM预训损失挂钩.

articles.title: SEE Challenge 2026: Event-Guided Brightness Adjustment Across a Broad Illumination Range
articles.content: Event cameras provide a high dynamic range and preserve brightness-change cues in lighting conditions where conventional RGB frames may be noisy or saturated. To benchmark event-guided restoration across a broad illumination range, we organized the SEE Challenge 2026 with the Event-Based Multimodal Vision Workshop at ECCV 2026. The task conditions restoration on one or more RGB frames, synchronized events, and a scalar target-brightness statistic provided by the organizers. It uses SEE-600K, which contains 610,126 image-event observations from 202 real-world scenes spanning low-light, normal-light, and high-light conditions with illumination variations of up to 1,000$\times$. The challenge follows an open-system protocol: participants may use different temporal contexts, architectures, pretrained weights, test-time augmentation, and post-processing strategies. PSNR determines the ranking, and SSIM is reported as a secondary metric. Around 70 teams registered interest and 15 valid CodaBench submissions were received. Six distinct teams completed organizer-side identity and technical verification, provided method descriptions, checkpoints, inference code, and instructions, and are included in the verified open-system ranking reported here. Beyond the ranking, this report analyzes exposure subsets, semantically distinct test cases, a shared failure pattern, system design choices, and inference strategies. The top systems obtain closely spaced average scores, while the best-performing method varies across cases and metrics; under severe underexposure, all verified systems retain visible local errors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: See Challenge 2026:事件指引亮度调整跨大光圈范围
articles.content_zh: 事件相机提供高动态范围,在常规RGB帧可能吵闹或饱和的照明条件下保持亮度变化提示. 为了在广泛的照明范围以事件指导的恢复为基准,我们在ECCV 2026举办了基于事件的多模式展望讲习班,以此举办了东南欧挑战2026。 任务条件在一个或多个 RGB 帧上恢复,同步事件,以及组织者提供的scalar目标亮度统计. 它使用SE-600K,包含来自202个真实世界场景的610,126个图像-事件观测,跨越了低光,平平光,高光等条件,发光变化可达1000美元\times$. 挑战遵循开放系统协议:参与者可能使用不同的时间背景,架构,预先训练的权重,测试时间增强,以及后处理策略. PSNR确定排名,SSIM作为二级度量衡报告. 约70个小组登记了利息,收到了15份有效的Coda Bench申请。 6个不同的小组完成了组织者-侧身份和技术核查,提供了方法说明、检查站、推断代码和指示,并列入此处报告的经核实的开放系统排名。 除了排名之外,本报告还分析了暴露子集、明显不同的测试案例、共同的失败模式、系统设计选择和推断策略。 顶级系统获得相距相近的平均分数,而表现最好的方法则因案例和度量而异;在严重暴露不足的情况下,所有已核实的系统都保留了明显的局部出错.

articles.title: A Study of the Limits of Collaborative DCT-Based Image Denoising via Interpretable Neural Networks
articles.content: Image denoising remains a fundamental problem in image restoration, with applications in photography, biomedical, and scientific imaging. Modern deep neural networks achieve strong performance by learning powerful image priors, but often rely on large black-box models with limited interpretability. In contrast, DCT-based sliding-window and collaborative filtering methods such as BM3D offer clear algorithmic structure, but depend on handcrafted and non-differentiable operations. This work studies how far such structured collaborative filtering principles can be pushed when reformulated as trainable models. We introduce DeepBM3D, a compact fully differentiable architecture that combines non-local patch grouping, DCT-domain filtering, and multi-stage refinement within a BM3D-inspired pipeline. Lightweight convolutional feature extractors guide patch grouping, while filtering is performed through learned Wiener weights in the DCT domain. Experiments show that DeepBM3D improves over classical and hybrid baselines, remains competitive with FFDNet at low and moderate noise levels, and performs particularly well on repetitive textures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于基于DCT的协作图像通过可解释神经网络去化的限制的研究
articles.content_zh: 图像去诺化仍然是图像修复的一个根本问题,在摄影,生物医学和科学成像方面的应用. 现代深层神经网络通过学习强力图像前传来实现强性能,但往往依赖于具有有限可解释性的大型黑盒模型. 相形之下,基于DCT的滑窗和BM3D等协作过滤方法提供了清晰的算法结构,但依赖于手工和无差别的操作. 这项工作研究了这种结构化的协作过滤原则在重新制定为可训练模型时可在多大程度上被推动。 我们引入了DeepBM3D,一种完全相异的紧凑结构,结合了非局部的补丁分组,DCT-域过滤,以及BM3D-启发管内多相改进. 轻量级演化特性提取器导出补丁分组,而滤取则通过DCT域所学的Wiener重来进行. 实验表明,DeepBM3D比起古典和混合基线有所改进,在低和中度噪音水平上仍然与FFDNet具有竞争力,在重复纹理上表现特别好.

articles.title: Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning: A Closest-Admissible Solution
articles.content: Existing continual-learning methods protect parameters, replayed examples, or Euclidean feature subspaces. When applied to hyperbolic multimodal models, they do not explicitly preserve the Lorentz geometry that jointly encodes within-modality similarity, cross-modal correspondence, and semantic hierarchy; sequential updates can therefore retain task scores while still distorting previously learned relations. We address this gap with Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning (HMCL). We show that preserving the old multimodal geometry amounts to restricting all modalities to one shared hyperbolic isometry, which induces a family of admissible first-order parameter changes. We formulate a joint closest-admissible (CA) correction that retains the shared rotation best matching the candidate modal updates; its minimal-rotation (MR) special case fixes this rotation to zero. Both variants correct the displacement realized by AdamW, and task anchoring bounds within-task accumulation while preserving learning freedom. Across a unified 16-task classification-retrieval stream with three hyperbolic backbones, HMCL improves final performance and backward transfer over sequential fine-tuning and four continual-learning baselines; HMCL-CA gives the highest Overall score on every backbone. A modality-extended stream confirms the retrieval gains. Representation analyses find 81.2 to 95.5 percent less radial, angular, cross-modal, and paired-distance drift; ImageNet-WordNet results show better semantic ancestry and radial hierarchy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 双曲多模式连续学习:最接近可允许的解决方案
articles.content_zh: 现有的持续学习方法保护参数,重放实例,或欧几利得地特征子空间. 当被应用到双曲多模式模型时,它们并不明确保留Lorentz几何,它们共同编码了模式内相似性,跨模式函证,和语义等级;因此相继更新可以保留任务分数,而同时又会扭曲先前所学关系. 我们通过双曲多式继续学习来解决这一差距。 我们显示,保留旧多式几何,等于将所有模式限制在一个共享的双曲同位素上,这会导致一组可允许的一阶参数变化。 我们拟定一个最接近可接受的联合更正,保留与候选模式更新最匹配的共享轮换;其最小轮换的特殊情况将这一轮换固定为零。 这两种变体都纠正了AdamW所实现的流离失所现象,任务锁定在任务内积累,同时维护学习自由。 通过一个统一的16个任务分类检索流,并有3个双曲线主干线,HMCL改进了最终性能和后向转移,超过了相继的微调和4个持续学习基线;HMCL-CA给予每个主干线最高的总分. 一个模式延伸的流证实了检索收益。 代表性分析发现,射线、角线、跨模式和对接-相距漂移的数值减少81.2%至95.5%;ImageNet-WordNet的结果显示,语义祖先和射线等级较好。

articles.title: EgoSpeedUp: Transferring Human Manipulation Tempo to Robot Policies
articles.content: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning inherit not only the demonstrated behavior but also the conservative execution tempo of robot demonstrations. Existing acceleration approaches can execute faster than the original demonstrations, but determine the appropriate acceleration primarily from robot-side information or a predefined set of tempo factors, leaving open how to obtain a task-appropriate reference for how fast each manipulation phase should progress. We introduce EgoSpeedUp, a framework that uses human manipulation as temporal supervision for robot imitation learning. Our key insight is that human demonstrations naturally reveal task-appropriate, phase-wise manipulation tempo. Given slow robot demonstrations and human demonstrations of the same task, EgoSpeedUp aligns corresponding manipulation phases, estimates their relative execution tempos from multiple human demonstrations, and transfers the resulting phase-wise tempo by retiming the robot demonstrations. The retimed demonstrations are then used for standard behavior cloning, allowing the robot to retain its executable manipulation behavior while learning to perform it at a human-informed tempo. Across two real-world manipulation tasks, EgoSpeedUp improves the task success rate by an average of 25 percentage points (pp) while reducing successful execution time by 36.5%. These results demonstrate that human manipulation tempo provides an effective temporal reference for learning faster and more reliable robot policies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoSpeedUp: 将人类操纵时间转移到机器人政策
articles.content_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的机器人操纵政策不仅继承了所展示的行为,而且继承了机器人演示的保守执行节奏. 现有的加速法执行速度可以快于最初的演示,但主要通过机器人侧信息或预设的一组节奏因素来确定适当的加速,留下如何获得一个适合任务的参考,说明每个操纵阶段应进行多快. 我们引入了EgoSpeedUp,这个框架将人类操纵作为机器人模仿学习的时间监督. 我们的关键见解是,人类的示威自然揭示出适合任务的、分阶段的操纵节奏。 由于机器人演示速度缓慢,人类演示任务相同,"EgoSpeedUp"协调了相应的操纵阶段,从多起人类演示中估算出其相对执行节奏,并通过对机器人演示进行再刺激来转移所形成的相相位节奏. 重回时间的演示随后被用来进行标准的行为克隆,使机器人在学习以人知情的节奏进行时,能够保留其可执行的操纵行为. EgoSpeedUp在两项现实世界操纵任务中,平均将任务成功率提高25个百分点(pp),同时将成功执行时间缩短了36.5%. 这些结果表明,人类操纵节奏为学习更快和更可靠的机器人政策提供了有效的时间参考.

articles.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
articles.content:
Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. The main challenge is therefore not only recognizing conspiracy-related claims, but inferring the speaker's intent -- the utterance's illocutionary force. We argue that this can be achieved through the use of relevant social contexts and propose an agentic framework, equipped with a set of tools supporting social queries.
  We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on a unique dataset of Hebrew tweets, covering 80\%--90\% of the public Hebrew tweets published over a four-year span (late 2018-- early 2023), encompassing several election cycles as well as the COVID pandemic years and related vaccination campaigns. This extensive coverage can be used in recovering different social contexts. Evaluating our framework on a manually-annotated adversarial dataset, we find that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification and that the agentic framework performs significantly better than other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model exposed to the same contexts available to the agent. We further provide an analysis of the results, the errors and efficiency (token economy) tradeoffs.
  These findings support viewing the task of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task, in which effective classification depends not only on access to contexts, but also on adaptive reasoning in which the agent uses tools on a per-case basis, asking only for evidence relevant to its current reasoning step.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 网上阴谋的代理检测
articles.content_zh:
有关社交媒体的阴谋性言论并不总是通过明确的诉求或稳定的词汇标记来表达. 同样的表面内容可能表达认可、合理关切、批评、讽刺或嘲弄。 因此,主要的挑战不仅是承认与阴谋有关的主张,而且还要推断演讲者的意图,即言论的不良力量。 我们主张,可以通过利用相关的社会环境来实现这一点,并提议一个代理框架,配备一套支持社会询问的工具.
我们展现了我们在希伯来语微博独特数据集上的做法的益处,该数据集涵盖为期四年(2018年末至2023年初)发表的公开希伯来语微博的80+-90++,涵盖多个选举周期以及COVID流行年和相关疫苗接种运动。 这种广泛的覆盖面可用于恢复不同的社会环境。 对人工说明的对抗数据集评估我们的框架,我们发现,了解上下文的工作流程一贯优于仅文本的分类,代理框架的表现大大优于其他框架和设置,包括一个接触代理商相同背景的非代理模式。 我们进一步分析了结果、错误和效率(经济)权衡。
这些调查结果支持将阴谋侦测任务视为一项社会嵌入式解释任务,其中有效的分类不仅取决于接触环境,还取决于代理人在个案基础上使用工具的适应性推理,仅要求与其当前推理步骤相关的证据.

articles.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
articles.content: Dedicated decision models such as Jev map unstructured language to probability distributions over finite choices, allowing their outputs to directly route requests, select tools, and trigger actions. Yet real-world inputs rarely arrive in isolation: they come with background details and surrounding context. We find that short additions that fit naturally into this context can nevertheless redirect an otherwise correct decision, even when the correct answer remains unchanged. To study this behavior, we fix a wrong target option for each initially correct item and use the model's option probabilities to refine fluent context additions while preserving the source, question, choices, and gold answer. Within 64 accepted target evaluations, the optimizer identifies contexts that redirect Jev on 312 of 508 initially correct decisions (61.4%); in 229 cases, Jev assigns at least 0.7 probability to the fixed wrong option. Across seven datasets, three additional decision systems show targeted flip rates of 64.9%-73.2% on decisions they initially answer correctly. Taken together, these results expose a pronounced fragility in current decision models: short, ordinary-looking context can shift a correct choice to a high-confidence wrong one. Because these models turn language directly into downstream choices, this sensitivity raises concerns about treating their probability outputs as reliable decision interfaces.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: JevOut: 自然背景可以翻转决定模式
articles.content_zh: Jev映射出无结构语言等专用决定模型,以概率分布于有限的选择之上,允许其输出直接路由请求,选择工具,并触发行动. 然而,现实世界的投入很少孤立地出现:它们提供了背景细节和周围背景。 我们发现,自然适合这一背景的简短补充可以改变本来正确的决定的方向,即使正确的答案保持不变。 为了研究这一行为,我们为每个最初正确的项目定出一个错误的目标选项,并利用模型的选项概率来完善流畅的上下文添加,同时保留源,问题,选择和黄金答案. 在64个被接受的目标评价中,优化者确定了将Jev重定向于508个最初正确决定中的312个(61.4%)的背景;在229个案例中,Jev将至少0.7的概率分配给了固定错误的选项. 在7个数据集中,另外3个决策系统显示,在最初正确回答的决定中,目标翻转率为64.9%-73.2%。 综合起来,这些结果暴露出当前决策模式的明显脆弱性:短而平凡的背景可以将正确的选择转向高度自信的错误选择。 因为这些模型将语言直接转化为下游选择,这种敏感性引起了人们对于将它们的概率输出作为可靠的决策界面的担忧.

articles.title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
articles.content: Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. However, these methods still suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance due to the lack of high-level semantic grounding in partially observed multimodal evidence. To address these issues, we propose SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that constructs rich sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs, fully integrating with all modalities via anchor-free spectral alignment. It mainly consists of Cross-modal Semantic Refinement (CSR) and Cross-modal Spectral Alignment (CSA). Specifically, CSR first adaptively extracts visual and acoustic representations by corresponding adapters to form a unified multimodal prefix with language in the frozen LLM embedding space. It then iteratively produces continuous discriminative semantic states through a token-efficient latent refinement process without decoding explicit text. Next, CSA simultaneously aligns the refined semantics with all modalities by enhancing the dominant spectral component of their kernel Gram matrix. This captures global nonlinear dependencies among all representations without relying on a predefined anchor modality. In addition, an instance-level spectral separation constraint preserves cross-sample discriminability and mitigates representation collapse. Extensive experiments on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that SemMSA achieves state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SemMSA:有不完整数据的Latet语义辅助强力多式传感器分析
articles.content_zh: 最近对多模式感知分析(MSA)的研究侧重于从语言,视觉,和声学模式中学习,数据不全可以推断出人类的情绪. 大多数研究通常通过重建模式特征或设计复杂的聚变机制来弥补缺失的信息. 然而,由于在部分观察到的多式联运证据中缺乏高层次的语义基础,这些方法仍然受到虚假的生成和噪音的引导。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用SemMSA这一潜在的语义辅助框架,用LLMs构建与情绪相关的丰富的语义,并通过无锚谱相接与所有模式充分结合。 它主要由"跨模式语义精准"(CSR)和"跨模式分光调和"(CSA)组成. 具体而言,CSR首先适应性地从相应的适配器中提取视觉和相声表现,以形成一个统一的多模式前缀并带有被冻结的LLM嵌入空间中语言. 然后,它通过一种象征性的高效的潜在完善过程,而无需对明文文本进行解码,反复产生持续的歧视性语义状态。 其次,加空局通过增强内核克拉姆矩阵的主要光谱成分,同时将精细语义与所有模式相协调. 这捕捉了全球所有代表的非线性依赖性,而不依赖于预先确定的锚定模式。 此外,实例一级的光谱分离制约保持了跨样本的可分性并缓解了代表性崩溃. 对SIMS,MOSI,MOSEI基准的广泛实验表明,SemMSA实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
articles.content: Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verification ability transfers from text to speech, and whether retrieval-augmented LALMs can use textual evidence to correctly support or refute spoken claims. Our experiments reveal a consistent text-speech modality gap: LALMs that verify written claims reliably often fail on the same claims when spoken. Moreover, retrieval alone provides limited gains because models frequently conflate retrieved evidence with the spoken claim. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy. VeriSpeak highlights that effective speech misinformation detection requires not only speech understanding, but also grounded reasoning over retrieved evidence. The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 信任或不信任:在演讲中检查已获取的事实
articles.content_zh: 网上错误信息越来越多地以口语形式出现,如新闻剪辑、播客、采访、政治演讲以及社交媒体视频等,因此需要建立能够直接从言论中核实指控的事实核查系统。 我们引入了Verispeak(英语:Verispeak),这是研究大型音频语言模型(LALMs)中基于语音的事实验证的探测基准. Verispeak包含3,879个口头主张,涉及时间、地域和关系事实,并有平衡的真假标签。 该基准旨在审查事实上的核实能力是否从文本转移到语音,以及检索到的LALM是否可以使用文字证据来正确支持或反驳口头主张. 我们的实验揭示了一个一致的文字表达模式空白: 可靠地核实书面索赔的LALM在说话时往往不能处理同样的索赔。 此外,单是检索就可带来有限的收益,因为模型常常将检索到的证据与口头索赔相混淆。 与此相反,检索与明确推理相结合,改进了索赔-证据比较,经过思考的LALM达到了86.1%的准确度. VeriSpeak强调,有效的语音错误检测不仅需要语音理解,还需要对所取出的证据进行有根据的推理. 该数据集通过Hugging Face在https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/Verispeak上公开提供.

articles.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
articles.content: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PoEM:从现有政策中预测RL成果
articles.content_zh: 基础模型通过强化学习(RL)进行后培训,以尽量扩大具体奖励,例如人与人结合、正确性或随行的教学。 这个训练后的过程在计算上是密集的,有时是不稳定的,必须从零开始运行,每次奖励模式改变,或者当我们想结合多种奖励时,都要从零开始运行. 因此,我们问:鉴于新的奖励功能,在不实际运行RL的情况下,是否能够预测RL结果? 我们以肯定的方式回答这个问题,引入了PoEM,这是一个框架,利用一套已经经过其他奖励培训的模式,预测RL在新的奖励职能方面的产出。 首先,我们表明,如果新的奖励函数可以被写成现有函数的线性组合,那么日志空间中的新政策就可以被写成现有日志策略的线性组合. 令人惊讶的是,即使在奖励没有线性联系的情况下,我们发现,来自RL训练的日志政策往往跨越了大约低等的亚空间,跨越奖励。 为了我们的利益,这种组合的加权系数只能利用抽样的奖励或政策产出的依据来估计。 我们把这些观测结果变成一个算法,它使用经过后训练的模型和新的奖励功能,并且不实际运行任何附加的RL训练而大致地计算目标RL政策. 我们通过综合和真实的奖励,包括文字和图像模式,试验验证我们的方法。

articles.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
articles.content: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.

articles.title_zh: 勘探 法官席:衡量AI系统在可验证的异形世界中的探索
articles.content_zh: 科学发现始于已知问题结束的地方. 在那里,AI系统必须参与探索:设定假设,设计实验,并追溯到结果. 然而,评估这种能力是困难的:(1) 如何核实一个真正新的假设是否存在;和(2) 如何确定一个系统是否通过探索发现了这种假设,或者仅仅从培训前的数据中回顾有关知识。 为此,我们引入了"探索奔驰"(Exploration Bench),它把评估科学探索的邪恶问题变成了一个建立在可核查的"异形世界"之上的具体而可操作的框架:他们的规则是可以执行的,因此每一个答案都能被精确地检查,并且与熟悉的知识相冲突,所以单独回忆无法解决这些任务. 该基准包含两个沙盒,"异形"(AlienCode)(31个发现目标,70个任务)和"异形"(AlienLogic)(24个发现目标,70个任务). 每个沙盒都提供有缺陷的手册,针对具体任务的环境反馈,以及专用的工具调用计划. 系统利用这些资源来探索沙盒,然后解决被搁置的任务. 我们评价了10个人工智能系统,发现最强的系统可以获取和适用不熟悉的规则,而各轨迹的性能则大相径庭,而继续探索则会拖延或逆转先前的收益. 探索奔驰是朝向AI系统迈出的一步,这种系统可以通过在未知环境中的探索获得并应用真正的新知识.

articles.title: ARGUS: Role-Aware Event Knowledge Graphs for U.S. Employment-Discrimination Complaints
articles.content: U.S. employment-discrimination complaints describe complex event sequences that are not explicitly captured by lexical or embedding-based representations alone. We present ARGUS, a source-grounded pipeline that combines a 5W1H-inspired schema, legal-domain models, and LLM-based structured generation to construct document-level Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) from CourtListener complaints. ARGUS extracts fact-bearing statements, builds chunk-level event graphs with participant, temporal, and causal structure, and merges them into document-level representations. We evaluate graph quality through human and multi-model assessment and test downstream utility on claim classification and legal QA. The graph-structured classifier outperforms raw and linearized baselines on the held-out set, and EKG-only retrieval improves document-scoped QA, while open-retrieval gains remain limited by low first-stage candidate recall. These results suggest that EKGs are most useful for organizing and reasoning over evidence once relevant material has been retrieved.

articles.title_zh: ARGUS:美国就业歧视投诉角色意识事件知识图
articles.content_zh: 美国的就业歧视投诉描述的是复杂事件序列,仅由词典或嵌入式表述并不能明确反映. 我们提出ARGUS,这是一个基于源头的管道,它结合了5W1H的灵感计划、法律领域模型和基于LLM的结构化生成,从法庭听取者的投诉中构建出文件级事件知识图。 ARGUS 提取包含事实的语句,与参与者建立块级事件图表,时间和因果结构,并合并为文件级表述. 我们通过人和多模型评估来评估图表质量,并测试下游对索赔分类和法律质量保证的效用。 图表结构分级器在被搁置的集中比生源和线性化基线表现优于生源和线性化基线,而只使用EKG的检索改进了文档范围QA,而开放检索收益仍然受到低一级候选人召回的限制. 这些结果表明,一旦相关材料被取出,EKG对于组织和推理证据最为有用。

articles.title: Do Audio Language Models Hear and Read Distinctive Features Alike?
articles.content: Audio language models pass speech and text through a single decoder. We ask whether that decoder represents a distinctive feature in the same direction when a phoneme is heard and when it is read. For minimal pairs of phonemes differing in one feature, we take the offset between the two members' mean representations. Averaging those offsets gives a direction for each stream, and we measure the cosine between the two. Because the two streams already agree about arbitrary phoneme pairs, we compare every measure against a reference built from random pairings rather than against zero. We apply this to 6 models, 7 features and 15 languages from 11 families. Only voicing in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models exceeds that reference after correction for multiple testing, and the reference varies by a factor of seven between models. In three of the six models, voicing has one direction in audio across the 14 languages with enough minimal pairs to measure it, and every language pair agrees in two of them. The model family, not the model size, predicts which stream represents a feature.

articles.title_zh: 音频语言模型听取和读取不同特征吗?
articles.content_zh: 音频语言模型通过单个解码器通过语音和文本. 我们问,当电话被听到和读取时,这个解码器是否代表着同一方向的一个显著特征。 对于一个特点不同的最低限度的对电话,我们取两个成员中间的平分。 分析这些相抵值为每条流提供了方向,我们测量两者之间的余弦. 因为两条流已经同意任意的对电话, 我们比较了每一个量度 与从随机对对而不是从零建立的参照。 我们将此应用于来自11个家庭的6个模式、7个特征和15个语言。 在两个Quen2.5-Omni模型中,只有对多次测试进行校正后,发票的写出量超过了该参考值,而模型之间的参考值则相差7个系数. 在6个型号中的3个型号中,发音在14个语言的音频中有一个方向,足够最小的对来测量,每对语言在其中两个型号中都同意. 模型家族,而不是模型大小,预测哪个流代表一个特征.

articles.title: A Training Criterion with Token-Level Tolerance to Transcription Ambiguity for Automatic Speech Recognition
articles.content: Automatic speech recognition is typically trained assuming that the reference transcript is the only valid labeling of an utterance, yet even nominally verbatim transcripts contain localized differences in pronunciation, spelling, or lexical realization that the acoustics do not uniquely determine. Omni-temporal Classification (OTC) tolerates such noise by adding wildcard paths to the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) alignment graph, but its word-level arcs are too coarse, since bypassing one unsupported token discards supervision for the whole word. We move wildcard arcs to token granularity so unsupported tokens can be bypassed while the rest of the word stays supervised, and we combine token- and word-level arcs as complementary escape paths. Across 19 languages and three corpora, token-level OTC improves over CTC on all 25 tasks. We also replace epoch-indexed relaxation of the wildcard weights with a predictive-entropy-indexed schedule, which performs comparably while reducing dependence on training length. Combining this schedule with the hybrid graph gives the lowest mean word error rate (WER) on every corpus and a 9.45% average relative WER reduction over CTC. Independent validator transcriptions show that token-level models place significantly more wildcard-bypass probability than CTC on disputed characters, indicating that token-level tolerance targets localized transcript ambiguity.

articles.title_zh: 以Token-level容忍方式提供的培训标准,用于自动语音识别
articles.content_zh: 自动语音识别一般是经过训练的,假设参考语录是语音唯一有效的标签,而即使是名义上的逐字记录也包含发音,拼写,或词典认知的本地化差异,声学并不独有地决定. Omni-timoral Classion(OTC)通过在连接论时间分类(CTC)对齐图中添加通配符路径来容忍这种噪声,但其词层弧度过于粗糙,因为绕过一个没有支持的符号会丢弃整个词的监管. 我们把通配符弧移到符号颗粒上,这样在其余的词被监视时,不支持的符号就可以被绕过,我们把符号-和词级的弧作为互补的逃生路径进行组合. 在19种语言和3个公司中,信使级的OTC在所有25个任务上都比反恐委员会有所改进。 我们还用一个预测-内向-索引时间表来取代按时代指数调整的通配符权重,该时间表在减少对训练时间的依赖的同时,具有可比性。 将这个表与混合图结合起来,可以得出每个实体的最低平均字差(WER),比CTC的平均WER减少9.4%. 独立验证员的笔录显示,同CTC相比,信使级模型对有争议字符的通配符比通配符概率要高得多,表明信使级可容忍度目标为本地化的语录模糊.

articles.title: Does a model's stated reason for rejecting a candidate do any work?
articles.content: Asked to choose between candidates and explain the choice, a language model often rejects a rival by naming a fact its profile lacks: no director, no date of death. That sentence is a claim about the text in front of the model, and it can be tested without any judge. We insert a real corpus sentence stating the named fact into the rival's profile and ask again under greedy decoding. Two controls separate content from placement: a length-matched irrelevant sentence at the same profile, and the same two sentences at a third option the model never mentioned. In the largest of three runs, six open models on 2WikiMultihopQA, supplying the named fact at the profile the model named moves its choice more than the irrelevant control does, odds ratio 3.57 [1.54, 8.26], Holm p=0.0210, and this survives dropping any single model. The contrast the design was built to detect, the same fact at the option nobody named, does not clear correction, Holm p=0.2428. The strongest result in the family carries no content claim at all: the identical irrelevant sentence moves the choice more at the named rival than at the third option, Holm p=0.0008. Repair and control also differ in co-candidate mentions, relation template and fluency; post-hoc matching on the first two preserves the content effects' direction, matching fluency weakens one, so the content contrasts bound an effect rather than establish one. A forced single-token probability read disagrees in direction with the free-text choice on that same contrast, and three candidate explanations for the disagreement find no support. Every measurement is a string rule, so each was validated against the records it reads; validation caught eight defects. The largest, a choice-parsing rule that returned the option a model had just rejected in 17.1% of adjudicable responses, would have reported six surviving contrasts instead of four.

articles.title_zh: 一个模特儿所说的拒绝候选人的理由 是否做任何工作?
articles.content_zh: 被要求在候选人之间做出选择并解释选择,一个语言模型常常通过命名一个其简介所缺乏的事实来拒绝对手:没有导演,没有死亡日期. 该句是对模型前的文字的主张,可以在没有法官的情况下进行测试. 在竞争对手的档案中插入一个写实事实的句子 然后在贪婪的解码下再问一遍 两个控件将内容和放置分开:一个长度匹配的不相干句子在同一剖面上,以及模型从未提及的第三个选项上相同的两句. 在三次运行中最大的一次是2Wiki MultihopQA上的6个开放型号,在配置图上提供命名的事实,命名型号比无关的控制更能选择,概率比3.57 [1.54, 8.26], Holm p=0.0210,这能活下来 任何单一的模型。 对比度 设计是用来检测的,同样的事实 在选项上,没有人命名, 没有明确的校正, Holm p=0.2428. 家族中最强的结果根本没有内容要求:相同的不相干句子比起第三种选择Holm p=0.0008,更动了被命名对手的选择. 修补和控制在共同candidate的提及,关系模板和流畅度方面也有所不同;前两款的后热相配可以保留内容效果的方向,相配流畅度会削弱一个,因此内容对比约束一个效果而不是建立一个. 强迫的一键概率读取方向与在同一对比上的自由文本选择不一致,对分歧的三种候选解释得不到支持. 每一次测量都是字符串规则,所以每个都根据它所读的记录进行了验证;验证发现有8个缺陷. 最大的,一个选择分配规则 返回选择 一个模型刚刚拒绝了 在17.1%的可置信的答复,

articles.title: GRASP: Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning with Agentic AI
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing $\textbf{GRASP}$, a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines (GenPlan), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows (RevPlan), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator (VerPlan). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling ($\sim$12.4$\%$$\uparrow$), ZebraLogic ($\sim$30.8$\%$$\uparrow$), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling-where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse-GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7$\%$ over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5$\%$.

articles.title_zh: 巨猿生存方案:与大赦国际代理机构合作制定、修订和评估战略规划
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)一般表现出性能特征,随着任务复杂性的增加,可靠性会下降. 我们通过引入$\textbf{GRASP}$($\textbf{GRASP}$)这一具有战略意识的多阶段规划框架来应对为复杂任务制定高质量的自然语言可执行计划的挑战。 GRASP将规划管道脱钩,跨越专业的,上下文同化的模块:它预编出全球宏观指南(GenPlan),在孤立的上下文窗口(RevPlan)内探索替代本地化战略(RevPlan),并使用多标准歧视者(VerPlan)独立评价轨迹. 经验性评价表明,巨猿生存方案在各种数据集方面一贯建立一个最新领域,在自然计划日历日程安排(12.4美元等),斑马洛吉克(30.8美元等)和Sci Bench Math方面,比直接的LLM规划人员提高了相当高的准确度。 关键是,在多任务推广中,标准规划人员立即遭遇性能崩溃,而巨猿生存方案则完全平息了多任务退化处罚。 在互不关联的双任务环境中,巨猿生存方案比直接的LLM规划者实现16.7美元-%的绝对准确性收益. 此外,巨猿生存方案通过孤立背景和实行严格的宏观规范,在前沿推理模型(如GPT-5-mini)上的表现比14.5美元差。

articles.title: Screen Before You Serve: Simulation for Production Customer Experience AI Agents at 140M Scale
articles.content:
Customer experience (CX) agents use tools and large language models to address customer requests and guide conversational interactions with an organization's products. Improving these agents, especially in regulated industries, is difficult: they must detect intent, follow complex operational policies and use tools reliably. Manual end-to-end testing offers limited coverage, while live experiments expose customers to failures that can erode trust.
  We present a hypothesis-driven simulation workflow for screening candidate CX agents before deployment. Synthetic customers react to agent responses and simulated tool outputs enable multi-step agentic workflows without invoking production backends. We use the Snowglobe simulator on Nubank's Card Delivery agent and its expanded successor, Card Management - Nubank's highest-volume chat-support agent in Brazil. Across 4 deployed versions, simulated and production version-level binary evaluator scores show high correlation. Simulation-guided iteration increased transactional net promoter score (tNPS) by 36.69 points in a live A/B test. We also screened open-weight configurations in over 16,000 simulated conversations. In a subsequent live A/B test, the selected model increased self-service rate (SSR) by 8.82 percentage points to the highest level observed at Nubank, with no statistically significant change in tNPS. Simulation made broad exploration of models, reasoning settings, and prompts feasible without customer exposure, enabling production improvements that would have been impractical to pursue through live experimentation alone.
