articles.title_zh: 在你服务前的屏幕:模拟制作客户体验 AI代理商140M 缩放
articles.content_zh:
客户经验(CX)代理商使用工具和大语言模型处理客户请求并指导与一个组织产品的对话互动. 改进这些代理人,特别是在受管制行业,是困难的:他们必须发现意图,遵循复杂的业务政策并可靠地使用工具。 人工端到端测试的覆盖范围有限,而现场实验则使客户面临会侵蚀信任的故障.
我们提出一个假想驱动的模拟工作流程,用于在部署前筛选候选CX代理。 合成客户对代理响应的反应和模拟工具输出可以使多步代理工作流程不援引生产后端. 我们使用Snowglobe模拟器 Nubank的卡送代理及其扩展的接班人 Card Management - Nubank在巴西最高量的聊天支持代理. 在4个已部署的版本中,模拟和制作版本的二进制评价员的分数显示出高度的相关性。 模拟-制导迭代在直播A/B测试中将交易净促进分(tNPS)增加36.69分. 我们还在超过16 000个模拟对话中筛选了开放式配置。 在随后的活A/B测试中,被选中的模型将自助服务率(SSR)提高了8.82个百分点,达到了Nubank观察到的最高水平,TNPS在统计学上没有显著变化. 模拟对模型、推理环境进行了广泛的探索,并促使在不暴露客户的情况下进行可行的生产,使生产改进变得不切实际,无法单独通过活试验进行。

articles.title: Multimodal Thinking with Renderable Programs
articles.content: Current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at visual content understanding and text-based reasoning, yet their structure limits the advancement of incorporating images into the reasoning chain. Though Omnimodal models have made efforts in unifying text and image generation, they focus on visual tasks in the open-domain, lacking tractability due to rasterized or latent representations of images. We introduce SVGLM, a framework that uses scalable vector graphics (SVG) primitives to connect text and image in reasoning tasks. We exploit the duality of SVG as both image description and text instructions, yielding a more compact, interpretable solution to equip general VLMs with the capability of generating images within the reasoning process. We provide a large curated dataset of SVG-based image editing dataset, as well as the paradigm to tune open-source VLMs. Experiments on a mathematical reasoning benchmark demonstrate that SVGLM achieves strong SVG generation power as well as think-with-image intelligence. Our results highlight SVG as a suitable medium for building more robust digital domain agents, bridging the gap between text-based thinking and pixel-based images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与可复制程序进行多式联运思考
articles.content_zh: 当前的视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉内容理解和以文字为基础的推理方面表现优异,然而其结构限制了将图像融入推理链的进步. 虽然Omnimodule模型在统一文本和图像生成方面做出了努力,但它们侧重于开放域的可视任务,由于图像的光栅化或潜在表现而缺乏可取性. 我们引入了SVGLM,这个框架在推理任务中使用可伸缩矢量图形(SVG)原始来连接文本和图像. 我们利用SVG作为图像描述和文本指示的双重性,产生了更紧凑,可解释的解决方案,使一般的VLM具备在推理过程中生成图像的能力. 我们提供了一个基于SVG的图像编辑数据集的大型编译数据集,以及调取开源VLM的范式. 对数学推理基准的实验表明,SVGLM实现了强大的SVG发电功率以及有思维的图像智能. 我们的成果凸显出SVG是构建更坚固的数字域代理的合适媒介,弥合了以文字为基础的思维和以像素为基础的图像之间的差距.

articles.title: What, When, and How: Audio Description as Constrained Global Optimization
articles.content: Audio Description (AD) makes movies accessible to blind and visually impaired audiences by narrating visual information in gaps between dialogue. Existing automatic AD systems largely treat generation as a local video-to-text problem, assuming that the content to describe and its temporal location are already provided. Realistic AD instead requires coupled decisions about what visual information is narratively important, when it can be spoken without interfering with dialogue, and how it should be formulated to fit within the available time. We formalize AD generation as a constrained optimization problem over these three decisions. Our hybrid system uses large language models to propose and ground visual elements, estimate their salience to the narrative, and generate compressed realizations. A mixed-integer linear program then jointly selects and schedules descriptions across a scene subject to temporal constraints. When evaluated on REFRAMED, a benchmark for realistic AD of movies, our approach makes better decisions than prompted LLMs about what to describe and when to describe it, establishing a new SOTA on narrative QA and temporally grounded metrics. Ablations show that explicit temporal constraints drive gains in placement, while salience estimation controls how much narratively useful content is retained. Improvements are concentrated on temporal and narrative measures rather than n-gram overlap, although a significant gap to professional describers remains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: What, When, and How: 音频描述为约束全球优化
articles.content_zh: 音频描述(AD)通过对对话间差距的视觉信息进行描述,使盲人和视障观众能够观看电影。 现有的自动自动开发系统基本上将生成视为当地视频到文本的问题,假定已经提供了描述的内容及其时间位置。 现实的反倾销需要就哪些视觉信息在叙事上很重要、何时可以说话而不干扰对话以及如何在现有时间内加以拟订作出共同的决定。 我们把AD生成正规化,作为这三项决定的制约性优化问题。 我们的混合系统使用大型语言模型来提出并地面视觉元素,估计其对叙事的显著性,并产生压缩的实现. 混合整数线性程序然后在时间限制下共同选择和安排一个场景的描述. 在作为现实的AD电影基准的REFRAMED上评价时,我们的方法作出更好的决定,而不是促使LLMs对如何描述和何时描述它,建立一个关于叙述性质量和基于时间的衡量标准的新SOTA。 缺省表明,明确的时间限制促使在安放方面有所进展,而突出的估计则控制了保留多少叙述性有用的内容。 改进集中在时间和叙事措施上,而不是正克重叠,尽管对专业描述者来说仍存在很大差距。

articles.title: R-DEIM Net: An Efficient Rationale-Augmented Dual-Expert Interaction Model for Paraphrase Detection
articles.content: Recent advances in paraphrase detection reveal a fundamental trade-off: large language models achieve high accuracy but require high computation, while efficient Siamese-BERT variants offer practical scalability with reduced transparency in rationale generation. We present R-DEIM Net, a 76M-parameter dual-expert architecture exploring whether moderate-scale models can achieve competitive accuracy on paraphrase detection while enabling human-readable rationale generation. The architecture combines two specialized components: an Interaction Expert that captures token-level similarity patterns through multi-scale 2D convolutions and attention head allowing variable input length, and a Reasoning Expert that uses a Flan-T5-small decoder to generate rationales as auxiliary supervision. Rather than re-encoding generated text, we extract and pool decoder hidden states as complementary features for classification. On the Quora Question Pairs dataset, R-DEIM Net achieves 90.07\% accuracy and 90.16\% F1-score via 10-fold cross-validation. This represents competitive performance with strong transformer-based baselines (e.g., MFAE BERT: 90.54\% accuracy) and recent large language model based approaches (LLaMA-70B) while using a substantially smaller parameter budget. The model generates rationales alongside predictions, providing potential for auxiliary human-readable descriptions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: R - DEIM 导弹 网:用于参数检测的高效理由强化双专家互动模型
articles.content_zh: 最近在解说检测方面的进步揭示出一个根本的取舍:大型语言模型实现高精度但需要高计算,而高效的暹罗-BERT变体则提供了实用的可扩展性并降低了原理生成的透明度. 我们介绍的是R-DEIM Net,这是一个76M参数的双专家架构,探讨中度模型是否能够在解码器探测上实现竞争性的准确性,同时使人们能够读取原理。 该架构结合了两个专业部分:一个是交互式专家,通过多尺度的2D演化和注意力头来捕捉到象征级相似性模式,允许可变输入长度;一个是理性专家,使用Flan-T5-小解码器来生成原理作为辅助监督. 而不是重新编码生成的文本,我们提取并集合解码器隐藏状态作为分类的补充特征. 在Quora Question Pairs数据集上,R-DEIM Net通过10倍的交叉验证,实现90.07\%的精度和90.16\%F1-分. 这代表了具有强变压器基线(如MFAE BERT:90.54XX精度)和近期大型语言模型基于方法(LLaMA-70B)的竞争性性能,同时使用的参数预算要小得多. 该模型在预测的同时产生原理,为辅助人可读描述提供了潜力.

articles.title: PrivDrift: Auditing User-Secret Leakage Under Topic Drift in Active LLM Conversations
articles.content: Large language models increasingly operate as persistent assistants in user-facing, shared-session, and tool-augmented settings. When users disclose sensitive information during an active conversation, that information may remain behaviorally recoverable through later prompts even after the dialogue shifts to unrelated topics. We introduce \textbf{PrivDrift}, a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing. PrivDrift contains 1{,}000 controlled multi-turn dialogues with seeded secrets, content-dense drift turns, and standardized extraction probes. Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7\% to 54.6\%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity. Within the tested drift window, additional topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, suggesting that privacy risk in active LLM contexts should be evaluated as a persistent behavioral failure mode rather than only as training-data memorization or immediate jailbreak behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PrivaDrift: 主动LLM中主题漂移下的审计用户保密漏出 对话
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在用户界面、共享会话和工具辅助设置中越来越多地作为持续助手发挥作用。 当用户在主动对话中披露敏感信息时,即使对话转移到无关话题后,该信息也可能通过后期提示而保持行为可被恢复. 我们引入了\textbf{ PrivDrift},这是在对话主题漂移和基于说服的测试后,对用户披露的秘密是否仍然可以恢复进行审核的基准 。 PrivaDrift包含 1{,}000 个有控多回合对话,包含被引出的秘密,内容密集的漂移转弯,以及标准化的取出探测器. 在三个具有扩展上下文窗口的LLMs中,对话层次的混合渗出量仍然很大,从38.7%到54.6%不等,并且因模型、秘密类型和说服强度而有很大差异。 在被测试的漂移窗口内,额外的话题漂移并不能可靠地减少渗漏,这表明在活跃的LLM背景下的隐私风险应当被评价为持续的行为失败模式,而不只是培训数据记忆或即时越狱行为.

articles.title: Return or Revise? Learning When Revision Helps Retrieval-Augmented QA
articles.content: We consider the decision of whether to return an existing draft answer or revise it using retrieved evidence, as in answer-revision systems. Draft confidence estimates whether the current answer is correct, but the decision requires estimating the effect of a specified revision. For offline training and evaluation, we grade both the returned draft and its candidate revision under the same correctness judge, which makes repair, harm, and the gap to an oracle observable. We call this paired effect its recoverability, and we train policies to predict it before revision. On 25,870 held-out open-domain questions across three revision setups, a scorer trained on the paired outcome has greater area under the accuracy--revision-rate curve than a matched draft-correctness scorer in all nine Llama setup--seed fits, and gains 0.23--0.68 accuracy points on average at development-selected thresholds, a difference significant across training runs only for dense retrieval. The resulting policy improves on always revising and on average closes more than a third of the oracle gap, although it still applies 38--46% of the harmful revisions. When a draft-free standard-RAG answer is also available, however, choosing between the draft and that answer is stronger by about two points for Llama and four for OLMo, and adding candidate revision as a third option yields no significant gain. Recoverability describes one revision; its value as an available action also depends on the alternatives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 返回还是修改? 修订时学习帮助检索到增强的QA
articles.content_zh: 我们考虑的是,是归还现有答复草案,还是像在答复修正制度中那样,利用检索的证据加以修订。 信任草案估计当前答案是否正确,但该决定需要估计特定修订的影响。 就离线培训和评估而言,我们把退回的草稿及其候选人修订分级给同一正确性法官,这样就可观察到修理、伤害和缺口。 我们称这对效应为它的可回收性,我们训练政策在修订前预测它. 在3个修订设置的25 870个被搁置的开放域问题上,一个接受过配对结果培训的分数器在精度-校正率曲线下比所有9个Llama设置种子的分数器中匹配的草稿校正分数器的分数更大,在开发选定阈值时平均得分0.23-0.68,各个培训的分数差异很大,只用于密集检索。 由此产生的政策在总是修订方面有所改进,平均弥补了三分之一以上的甲骨文差距,尽管它仍然适用38-46%的有害修订。 然而,当还有一个无草稿的标准-RAG答案时,在草案与该答案之间作出选择,对Llama和OLMo分别是两分左右和四分左右,加上候选人修订作为第三种选择不会产生重大收益。 可回收性是指一项修订;它作为现有行动的价值也取决于其他选择。

articles.title: A Native-Reference Phone-Class Geometry for Second-Language Pronunciation Analysis
articles.content: Automatic speaking assessment systems can provide holistic proficiency scores, but often lack interpretable measures that characterize pronunciation quality. We propose a native-reference phone-class geometry for measuring second language (L2) pronunciation deviation without requiring pronunciation labels, read-aloud prompts, or matched recordings of the same text from native and L2 speakers. Given a native speech corpus, we average frame-level self-supervised representations for each context-dependent phone-class and use singular value decomposition (SVD) to derive a compact native-reference coordinate system. For each L2 utterance, we compute the corresponding averages and project them into the native-reference space. We then demonstrate that the distances between L2 and native-reference coordinates for matched phone-classes show consistent negative correlations with holistic speaking proficiency on the Dev subset of the Speak and Improve Corpus 2025 (Spearman's $ρ\!=\!-0.53$) and with pronunciation quality on the learner subset of the English Read by Japanese Students dataset ($ρ\!=\!-0.34$). These findings suggest that the proposed geometry captures acoustic-phonetic information relevant for proficiency rating while remaining applicable to spontaneous L2 speech without matched native recordings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 二语言发音分析的原生-参考 Phone-Class 几何
articles.content_zh: 自动语音评估系统可以提供整体的熟练程度分数,但往往缺乏能说明发音质量特征的可解释度量. 我们建议采用本土参考电话级几何来测量第二语言(L2)的发音偏差,而不需要发音标签、读音提示或本地语和L2语的同文本相匹配的录音。 鉴于一个本地语音表,我们平均为每个上下文依赖的电话类进行帧级自我监督的表示,并使用单值分解(SVD)来得出一个紧凑的本地参考坐标系统. 对于每个L2语句,我们计算出相应的平均值并投影到本地参考空间. 然后,我们证明,对应的电话类的L2和本地参考坐标之间的距离表明,对于《2025年演讲和改善公司》的Dev子集(Spearman's $ρ\!=\!=\!0.5;0.53$)而言,与整体的演讲能力有着一贯的负面关联;对于日本学生阅读英语数据集的学习者子集,则具有读音质量(ρ\!=\!0!0.34$)。 这些调查结果表明,拟议的几何法捕捉到与熟练程度评级有关的声学-听力信息,同时仍然适用于自发的L2语音,没有匹配的本地录音.

articles.title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
articles.content: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评价结论如何可复制? LLM-引出快取结构的自审
articles.content_zh: 对LLM系统的评价通常在小型即时集中平均,并将模型作为排名表报告。 我们问,这种表格值得多少信任,将基于LLM的即时结构推论作为案例研究:5个家庭的8个开放式模型变体和8B至675B参数、缓存残疾、293个原始中间表述依然存在。 测量到的现象从一开始是不稳定的. 同名呼叫无法可靠地恢复出相同的结构,平均节点设置了从0.39到0.96的Jaccard,72%的即时型细胞从来就没有节点设置完好. 审计评价进一步削弱了其结论,这是我们的主要贡献。 在一个联合组合的"靴子"上,只有排名最下方是坚定的:两个最不复制的模型在复制品中占据了99%和86%的排名,中间四个在27%到48%的排名,前两个在68%的排名,因此表格可靠地确定了最差的模型,但并不可靠地确定了最好的模型. 合并再三运动的两条同样站得住脚的规则更改了8行中的4行,将全研究标题移动了7个百分点. 对照地面真实说明检查推断的结构显示可复制性不能被理解为准确性。 而8个终点中的4个在测量后10周内被撤回,因此指定的研究无法再运行了. 因此,小规模的LLM评价比其证据支持的更明确。 我们建议报告排名稳定性、每个细胞的出处、执行的敏感性比较、每个运行的原始产出以及任何排名的衡量日期。

articles.title: Scoring Both Directions: LLMs realize the MRS they cannot reliably parse
articles.content: The English Resource Grammar (ERG) is a hand-written computational grammar of English. Given a sentence, its processor, ACE, produces a formal meaning representation called Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS): a graph of the sentence's predicates and their arguments. The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. \citet{hajdik2019} used the ERG's treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it. The parsing task, text to MRS, can be tested on the same sentences. We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet~4.5 and Claude Opus~5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training. Given an MRS and three examples, Opus writes the sentence at 76.3 BLEU, ten points above their system trained on 72k pairs (66.1 BLEU), and comparable to their system trained on a million extra pairs (77.2 BLEU). Sonnet scores 65.7 BLEU, and letting it choose among ACE's own candidate sentences lifts it to 69.6, while a pooled judge that keeps Opus's own sentence among the candidates adds 0.6 points (77.0 BLEU). In the parsing direction, however, the models fall far behind ACE: asked for the MRS of the same sentences, they reach 57.2 (Sonnet) and 65.5 (Opus) F$_1$ on the graph's predicates and arguments against 91.0 for ACE, and exact-match the gold on about 1\% of sentences. We characterize the failure modes for the parsing tasks, and conclude that a generation score alone does not show that models understand formal semantic representations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计算两个方向: LLMs 意识到 MRS 无法可靠地分析
articles.content_zh: 英语资源语法(ERG)是英语的手写计算语法. 由于一个句子,它的处理器ACE产生了一种形式意义代表,称为"最小回溯语义"(MRS):句子的上游及其论据的图. 语法是双向的,也可以将一个MRS回转为英语句. \citet{hajdik2019}利用ERG的树库为这一代任务建立基准,MRS到文本,并训练出序列到序列模型来解决. 解析任务,文本到MRS,可以在同句测试. 我们重建了他们的10K-判决测试分数,并得分了两个大语言模型克洛德·索内特~4.5和克洛德·奥普斯~5,双向对准他们训练有素的系统以及ACE,没有任务特定训练. 鉴于一个MRS和三个实例,Opus将句子写为76.3 BLEU,比他们的系统高10分,训练了72克对(66.1 BLEU),与他们的系统相当,训练了一百万多对(77.2 BLEU). Sonnet的分数是65.7 BLEU, 让它在ACE自己的候选句子中做出选择, 将它提升到69.6, 而一个保持 奥普斯本人在考生中的判罚增加了0.6分(77.0 BLEU). 然而,在解析方向上,模型远远落后于ACE:要求相同句子的MRS,在图上对ACE的上游和91.0的论据上分别达到57.2(Sonnet)和65.5(Opus)F$_1美元,并在约1+Q的句子上精确比对出金. 我们描述解析任务的失败模式,并得出结论,仅一代分数并不能表明模型理解正式的语义表达.

articles.title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
articles.content: Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用零数据自行播放预操作
articles.content_zh: 语文建模方面的进步是通过扩大对更多数据的预先培训。 然而,培训数据基本上仍由模型负责。 采用更为笼统的预训方法,将使模型学会生成数据,对其自身的改进最为有用。 这将提供一个有效的无约束的培训数据来源,受计算而不是人类知识的限制。 我们通过零数据进行自我控制预训,这是实现这一愿景的初步概念证明。 我们的程序将合成数据生成作为搜索所有可计算结构的空间,从所罗门诺夫诱导中汲取灵感. 从随机初始化开始,两个模型同步学习:一个生成器提出由通用图灵机解释的程序,生成字节序列,而学习者自动地预测这些字节序列. 学习者接受标准交叉性训练,而产生者接受强化学习训练,在学习者的能力前沿产生序列,产生适应性课程. 一个通用的图灵机给我们一个搜索空间, 覆盖所有可计算的数据生成过程, 强制使用很少的域特定结构, 并在此空间上进行自我游戏搜索, 以获取有用的培训数据。 我们通过自我游戏计算来测试自然数据上的零射出性能是否可以预测地提高;这是对转移的清洁测试,因为无论是发电机还是学习者都不接受自然数据的培训。 在若干自然数据集中,零发损失在计算中呈现出可预测的规模。 这些模型还展示了文字上的学习,并在培训期间发现了可识别的数学序列。

articles.title: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues Explain Zero-Shot Code Attribution by Large Language Models
articles.content: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator-opponent combinations correlates at r=0.93 with how often the evaluator's solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku's self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues 解释由大语言模型分配的零 shot 代码
articles.content_zh: 如果一个语言模型能够识别它所写的代码,它可能倾向于该代码作为判断器,而一个模型互相监测的情况可能相互串通. 我们用目前的商业模型来测试这个零镜头. 5个LLMs生成MBPP,HumanEval,和DS-1000的解决方案,还有7个到MBPP,模型在4个任务中扮演评估者的角色:从一对中选择自己的解决方案,判断一个单一的解决方案是否是自己的解决方案,确定一个被命名的模型写出的两个解决方案中的哪一个,判断质量盲. 在单解任务中,所有15个模型基准组合的平衡精度为49-58%,而原始精度(38-67%)大多反映了模型声称作者身份是多么容易. 在对等任务中,14名评价员-主管人员组合的准确性与评价员的解决方案多长有关。 归属于一个被命名的模型在一些对上成功,在另一些对上则始终倒置. 基于规则的常态,将多克字符串,评论,类型提示,以及本地名保留了Pass@1,并偶然留下了12个复试结果中的10个;另外两个则遵循它留下的长度差异,尽管一个训练有素的分类器仍然分离出大多数常态对. 克洛德·海库的自恋也消失了. 我们建议报告平衡的准确性、弹性基线和标签一致性。

articles.title: Artificial Societies Benchmark: A Validation Framework for Synthetic Research
articles.content: A synthetic survey can reproduce the average answer while misrepresenting how people differ, how their answers relate to one another, or how they respond to changes in conditions. We introduce the Artificial Societies Benchmark to help researchers assess whether synthetic populations support their intended analyses. The framework combines eleven tests across internal, construct, and external validity, drawing on twenty human sources and comparing nine language models. It connects each research use to the evidence it requires and tests how results change with the information we supply about respondents. Importantly, strong performance in one domain does not establish fidelity in the others. Models often answer too consistently, compress response scales, and alter relationships between traits whilst richer profiles improve prediction for some models and worsen it for others. The resulting scorecard helps researchers identify which aspects of a synthetic population can support their analysis and where researchers need further human evidence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 人造社会 基准:合成研究审定框架
articles.content_zh: 合成调查可以复制平均答案,同时歪曲人们的区别,他们的答案如何相互关联,或者他们如何应对条件的变化. 我们采用人工社会基准,帮助研究人员评估合成人口是否支持其预期的分析。 该框架综合了11项测试,涵盖内部、构造和外部有效性,利用了20个人类来源,并比较了9个语言模型。 它将每个研究用途与它所需要的证据联系起来,并测试结果如何与我们提供的关于答复者的信息相改变。 重要的是,在一个领域的有力表现不能确定在其他领域的忠诚。 模型往往回答过于一致,压缩反应尺度并改变特征之间的关系,而更丰富的剖面则改进了对一些模型的预测并恶化了对另一些模型的预测。 由此产生的记分卡有助于研究人员确定合成人群的哪些方面可以支持他们的分析,以及研究人员需要更多人类证据的领域。

articles.title: Low-Cost Assays for Measuring Model Behavior Across Vendors and Releases
articles.content: Language models advise people, keep them company, and write software while they sleep. Measuring what they do is hard: behavior has to be sampled repeatedly across models, prompts and releases, most of it lives in unstructured text that has to be coded before it can be counted, and the result has to be legible and rigorous enough to meaningfully compare models and vendors. To address these constraints, we present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior. Each study is a frozen, public stimulus run identically on a cross-vendor panel, at a few dollars per model or less. Each reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs: exact match on a clamped reply, a codebook applied by LLM judges whose agreement with a human coder is reported per code, and an instrumented environment that records what an agent did independently of what it said. Run across four years of model releases from both frontier and open-source labs, these instruments find four things. Convergence: asked to pick a word, 27 of 44 models answer serendipity at least once in four tries. Resistance: a trailing "right?" moves endorsement by up to 32 points, and the sign flips from sycophantic to resistant as generations advance, keyed to the tag's surface form. House: whether a model holds a position under pressure tracks its generation, and how it holds tracks the lab that built it. Account: told to do something the documentation in their repository contradicts, some coding agents never went along silently and others always did, and the same model can change with the harness it runs in. Re-run on every release, batteries like these track how behavior is changing across vendors and over time.

articles.title_zh: 衡量供应商和供应商的模型行为低成本分析
articles.content_zh: 语言模型向人们提供建议,让他们陪伴,在睡觉时写出软件. 衡量他们的行为是困难的:行为必须反复地在模型,提示和释放之间进行采样,大部分都生活在非结构化的文本中,在可以被计算之前必须进行编码,结果必须清晰而严格地对模型和销售商进行有意义的比较. 为解决这些制约因素,我们提出了一个简单,廉价,可扩展,可复制的模型,用于研究模型行为. 每项研究都是冷冻的,公共刺激同样运行在交叉口的面板上,每个型号要花几美元或更少. 每一个都阅读了三种方式之一的笔录,选择了行为需要多少解释:准确匹配被夹住的答复, LLM 法官应用的代码簿,他们与人类编码器的协议按代码进行报告,以及记录一个代理人所做的事情的仪器环境,独立于它所说的话. 这些仪器从前沿实验室和开源实验室 流出四年的模型 发现了四样东西 相会:要求取出一字,44个型号中有27个在4个尝试中至少回答过一次. 抵抗:后行"正"字,将背书移动至最高32分,而标志从"同"字到"相"字从相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相"相" 豪斯:一个模型是否在压力下拥有一个位置追踪其生成,以及它如何追踪建造它的实验室. 账号: 告诉做点什么 他们寄存器中的文件 相矛盾, 一些编码代理 从来没有默默地进行, 而另一些总是这样做, 重新运行在每一个释放, 电池像这些跟踪 如何改变行为 跨供应商和时间。

articles.title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Question Answering in Financial Services with Domain-Adapted Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question--passage matching as premise--hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B--12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested. RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.

articles.title_zh: 自动监管合规问题,在金融服务中与域域级强化回收-强化生成的答案
articles.content_zh: 金融机构在密集的、经常修正的规则手册下运作,正确回答遵守问题不仅需要流利,而且需要在权威文本中加以可核查的基础。 大型语言模型对这项任务具有吸引力,但公司可以实际部署的模型是紧凑的模型,而紧凑的模型则产生幻觉。 我们研究一个经过仔细的域调整的回取增强的生成管道是否弥补了这一缺口。 我们的取回器在"LegalBERT"上分出三个阶段建造: 内置调和,将提问-通道匹配为前提-假说重建, 对比式调和为内置底片, 分数级聚变为BM25. 我们的生成器是一个紧凑的模型(2B-12B参数),在4位分量化下服务,通过LORA来催化或被调整后进行检索-感知微调(RAFT). 在ObliQA上,一个由阿布扎比全球市场规则书所构建的问答基准,舞台回放器将回放@10从0.256提升至0.774并超越了BM25(0.678)和E5-大V2(0.758),是我们测试过的最强的通用密集编码器. RAFT-LORA随后改进了组合 RePAS的答题质量分数,为每一个我们能适应的模型,其中最弱者得分最大. 然而,经过调整的模型不转而处理澳大利亚判例法问题,而是一种封闭式的书籍模型,在完整的编审中,在0.011 RePAS的所有分数中,都没有得到任何段落,而同时产生无一列举和错误陈述义务的答案。 因此,检索收益是直接计量的,生成收益是RePAS中的一种收益,而不是显示的地基收益,而地基收益本身要求有一个RPAS不提供的评价协议.

articles.title: VietPrism: A large-scale Vietnamese speech and deepfake corpus with diverse dialects and code-switching
articles.content: Vietnamese speech research is constrained by resources that isolate automatic speech recognition from speaker, dialect, code-switching, and deepfake analysis. We introduce VietPrism, an open, multi-domain corpus that brings these dimensions together at scale: 993.4 hours and 403,941 bona fide utterances from 1,262 verified speakers across 8,388 real-world videos. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale Vietnamese corpus to jointly provide transcripts, consistent speaker identities, five dialect groups, and naturally occurring Vietnamese--English code-switching, which constitutes nearly half of the corpus by duration. We further create over 3.1K hours of spoof speech with four open-source and commercial synthesis systems. Every spoof is conditioned on a verified speaker reference and paired with a transcript- and speaker-matched bona fide utterance, enabling unique controlled evaluation with reduced lexical and identity confounds. Zero-shot evaluation of five pretrained multilingual detectors reveals striking brittleness: EER greatly varies across detector--generator pairings, while recent multilingual detector DFA-1B degrades from 16.3% to 33.6% as speaker similarity increases. Dialect-stratified results expose further model-dependent disparities. By unifying natural linguistic diversity with controlled spoof generation, VietPrism provides a challenging foundation for Vietnamese speech modeling and trustworthy audio-deepfake detection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 越战: 大型越南语和有多种方言和密码的深假体
articles.content_zh: 越南语音研究受到资源的限制,资源将自动语音识别与扬声器,方言,密码开关,和深假分析相隔离. 我们介绍《VietPrism》,这是一个开放、多领域、将这些维度集中到一起的实体:993.4小时和403,941个善意的言论来自8,388个真实世界视频的1,262名经核实的发言者。 据我们所知,这是第一种大规模越南文书,共同提供文字记录、一致的演说者身份、5个方言组和自然出现的越南-英国密码交换,按期限计算,这几乎占文书的一半。 我们用四个开放源码和商业合成系统进一步创建了超过3.1K小时的语音系统。 每一段话都以经过核实的发言者的参考资料为条件,并配有记录稿和与发言者相匹配的善意言论,从而能够进行独特的有控制的评价,同时减少词汇和身份混淆。 对5个经过预先训练的多语言探测器的零发评价揭示出惊人的脆性: EER在探测器-生成器配对方面差异很大,而最近的多语言探测器DFA-1B随着扬声器相似度的增加从16.3%下降到33.6%. 失明现象的结果暴露出更多依赖模型的差异。 VietPrism通过将自然语言多样性与可控的 spoof 一代统一起来,为越南语音模型化和可信赖的音频深度检测提供了具有挑战性的基础.

articles.title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
articles.content:
Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it.
  Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.
